notes.title: Livestream Plan ♥ Gift of Love
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41350040/bd9da15b56fca48447ddfa61722a66390176b2f7.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Want to know more about the famous streamer Miss Elf? Then enter her live stream channel and watch the happy daily life of Miss Elf and her friends![/p][p][/p][p]Livestream Plan ♥ Gift of Love begins. Participate in the event and interact with Miss Elf. Level up the Live Stream Channel to obtain Crystals, Messenger of Love Keychain, Ancient Willpower and more.[/p][p][/p][p]Time[/p][p]10:00, SEP 25 ~ 04:00, OCT 23[/p][p][/p][p]Required Level[/p][p]30 or higher[/p][p][/p][p]Details[/p][p]1. Miss Elf's live stream channel will be available for a limited time. Enter it and interact with Miss Elf by sending comments, giving gifts, and voting in polls to complete daily live stream missions and level up the live stream channel.[/p][p][/p][p]2. The maximum Live Stream Channel Level is 8. Once you reach Level 8, you can claim the new "Messenger of Love" AiPhone keychain. Live stream missions unlock daily at 04:00 from the start of the event until OCT 1. When the Live Stream Channel Level reaches the maximum, daily live stream missions will no longer refresh.[/p][p][/p][p]3. Complete daily event panel missions or sign in to the live stream channel to earn Jingle Coins. Spend Jingle Coins to buy gifts for Miss Elf in her live stream channel, and you might hear a message of thanks from her![/p][p][/p][p]4. After spending 1000/3000/6000/10000 Jingle Coins, your Fan Level and Title in the live stream channel will be upgraded, and your bullet comment tag will change accordingly.[/p][p][/p][p]*Ai-chan's Reminders:[/p][p]1. Before 04:00, OCT 1, you will not be able to purchase gifts in the live stream channel for that day once you've completed the daily live stream missions.[/p][p][/p][p]2. Jingle Coins will expire at 04:00, OCT 23 without return.[/p]

notes.title: Assemble! Summer Friendship Resort
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41350040/0cda484c702d68e4425c2bbcb5b3555d95b35760.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]A heart-throbbing game and a light-hearted adventure await. Have a summer filled with miracles at the Golden Courtyard![/p][p][/p][p]"Welcome to the World of Love created by a genius designer! Are you ready for a su... Yes, a surprise?"[/p][p][/p][p]Assemble! Summer Friendship Resort begins! Play the event to obtain Mad Pleasure: Shadowbringer's outfit "Roseate Summer", Summer at Golden Courtyard Emblem, Crystals, Source Prisms and more.[/p][p][/p][p]Assemble! Summer Friendship Resort[/p][p]Time[/p][p]10:00, AUG 28 ~ 04:00, OCT 23[/p][p][/p][p]Required Level[/p][p]30 or higher[/p][p][/p][p]Details[/p][p]1. This event features chibi-style map exploration. Four maps will be unlocked gradually. Complete all main story missions to obtain the Summer at Golden Courtyard Emblem.[/p][p][/p][p]2. While exploring different regions, you may encounter various Sidekicks. Collect these Sidekicks to assist your crew in battling, exploring, and constructing. Sidekicks have different abilities that correspond to map elements. When deployed strategically, these Sidekicks can help solve puzzles in maps and camps, as well as make combat easier.[/p][p][/p][p]3. When entering battle, strategically position characters or combat Sidekicks in 3 spots on the battlefield as the main combatant or supportive backups. During battle, freely reposition units to adapt to different combat situations.[/p][p][/p][p]4. Obtain various materials for building facilities through exploration and combat. Build facilities with different functions and create your dream home. Place Sidekicks in different facilities to gather materials faster, craft new items, and gain more. Items gained can be used to solve map puzzles and combat different weather conditions.[/p][p][/p][p]Abundant Love[/p][p]"Dear player, wait just a moment. Why not share a little love with the virtual world that 3.5 billion people dream of calling home?"[/p][p][/p][p]Time[/p][p]10:00, AUG 28 ~ 04:00, OCT 30[/p][p][/p][p]Required Level[/p][p]30 or higher[/p][p][/p][p]Rewards[/p][p]Play the event to earn Love at First Shot, which can be used in the event shop Abundant Love to exchange for Mad Pleasure: Shadowbringer's outfit "Roseate Summer", Crystals, Source Prisms, Honkai Shards and more![/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]*Ai-chan's Reminders:[/p][p]1. You can obtain enough Love at First Shot from the event to exchange for all the rewards in the event shop~[/p][p][/p][p]2. From 04:00, OCT 23 to 04:00, OCT 30, every 20 Love at First Shot can be purchased with 20 Crystals at Abundant Love. Limited to 99 purchases per Captain.[/p][p][/p][p]3. Love at First Shot will expire at 04:00, OCT 30 and return 750 Coins each.[/p]

notes.title: Coralie's new S-rank battlesuit "Behold! Fate-Defying Dragon" debuts!
notes.content: [p]☆☆☆☆☆ Behold! Fate-Defying Dragon ☆☆☆☆☆[/p][p]The dark lord rends the shadow of the divine, and the evil dragon burns eternity into cinders.[/p][p][/p][p]The wounds left by fate grow wings that transcend time, and the long night stained by death fuels the fire of civilization to burn ever brighter.[/p][p][/p][p]She spreads her wings in the blazing flames, a raging fire never to be vanquished.[/p][p][/p][p]"Because today is the future our senpais paved for us and the future we will pass on!"[/p][p][/p][p]"This is the permanence forged by humanity!"[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41350040/99cd251054dcb01d703bd1eaafd2432d8fb1c6cf.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]◆ How to Get the Battlesuit[/p][p]After the v8.4 update ~ 12:00, OCT 3, the Battlesuit Supply "Overlord of Annihilation" will be available. The featured S-rank battlesuit "Behold! Fate-Defying Dragon" is guaranteed in 90 drops with 50% off the first 10 drops.[/p][p][/p][p]During v8.4, Evil Dragon's Treasures will be available. Tap the button at the bottom of the bridge to receive a secret letter from Coralie. Open the mail to claim Battlesuit Supply Card x5.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]☆☆☆☆☆ Skill Showcase ☆☆☆☆☆[/p][p]Behold! Fate-Defying Dragon is a MECH-type Fire DMG dealer. All damage she deals is considered Ignite DMG, and she wields a Rocket Hammer. After clearing three trials, Coralie, the savior of the world, returns triumphantly in her dragon form. Behold, the genius Dark Lord![/p][p][/p][p]◆ Basic ATK: Abnormal Birth, Snowy Farewell[/p][p]Perform a 4-sequence Basic ATK on the ground or in the air to deal Fire DMG and inflict Ignite Trauma. After landing Basic ATK SEQ 4, tap \[Weapon] to connect into Special ATK "Rampant Dragon Claws".[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]◆ Special ATK: Life Beyond Death, Disillusioned by Trials[/p][p]After landing Basic ATK SEQ 4 or QTE, tap \[Weapon] quickly to perform "Rampant Dragon Claws", inflicting Ignite Trauma on enemies and gaining 1 stack of KE "Guzzled Flames". This also triggers global Time Fracture.[/p][p][/p][p]If the enemy has accumulated Trauma of a status ailment covered by the leader's traits, but does not have the status ailment, apply that Trauma to that enemy.[/p][p][/p][p]When equipped with the recommended Rocket Hammers "Draconic Sky-Scorching Fury" or "Draconic Sky-Scorching Fury: Ultra!", she inflicts more Ignite Trauma and her Special ATK deals more damage.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]◆ Ultimate: Draconic Permanence, Fiery Godslayer[/p][p]When she has KE, she can perform her Ultimate to deal damage while inflicting Ignite Trauma. During this time, she is invincible and Time-frozen Domain is in effect. In Stellar Outburst, the maximum stacks of KE "Guzzled Flames" increases to 3. When there's more than 1 stack of "Guzzled Flames", hold \[Special] to consume all stacks and increase her Ultimate's level to deal more damage.[/p][p][/p][p]Casting Ultimate consumes all remaining SP, and a percentage of it is converted into additional Fire DMG.[/p][p][/p][p]Upon casting Ultimate or entering Stellar Outburst, all teammates gain "Dragon's Dominion". They gain Elemental Breach or Physical Breach, and enemies take more Elemental DMG or Physical DMG from characters with this buff.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]◆ Astral Ring: Playing with Fate, Living for Today[/p][p]As the leader, when entering Stellar Outburst, she charges up to perform "Dragonbreath Onslaught". Hold \[Special] to increase her Dragonbreath level and deal more damage per level while inflicting Ignite Trauma.[/p][p][/p][p]After she breathes fire, she gains 1 stack of "Guzzled Flames". Then she can connect to Basic ATK SEQ 3 and SEQ 4.[/p][p][/p][p]As the leader, during Stellar Outburst, cast her Ultimate to exit Stellar Outburst and restore Astral Ring Intensity based on the remaining Astral Ring duration.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]☆☆☆☆☆ Key Rank-Up Skills ☆☆☆☆☆[/p][p]When she reaches S1, a new skill is unlocked. Enemies take more Elemental DMG and Physical DMG from characters with "Dragon's Dominion".[/p][p][/p][p]When she reaches S2, a new skill is unlocked and her sub-skill level cap is increased. When "Dragonbreath Onslaught" ends, global Time Fracture is triggered. When Behold! Fate-Defying Dragon is the leader and 2/3 team members are protected by Rite of Oblivion, Total DMG and Fire DMG dealt by her is increased.[/p][p][/p][p]When she reaches SS, a new skill is unlocked and her sub-skill level cap is increased. Ignite DMG dealt by her is increased. When Astral Ring is activated and teammates consume Stellar Drain, her switch CD reduction is increased.[/p][p][/p][p]When she reaches SSS, a new skill is unlocked. When Behold! Fate-Defying Dragon is the leader, her initial Astral Ring Intensity is increased.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]☆☆☆☆☆ Recommended Equipment ☆☆☆☆☆[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41350040/f937eb4c83e0676171c9cedbb00048f432f2e493.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]◆ Recommended Weapon: Draconic Sky-Scorching Fury[/p][p]Active Skill "Draconic Pressure": The weapon active's CD, max charges, and effects are based on the wielder's type. If the wielder has the Omniscient Star trait, she deals more Fire DMG. When equipped by Behold! Fate-Defying Dragon, her Enhanced Weapon Skill deals more Fire DMG, and she inflicts Ignite Trauma faster.[/p][p][/p][p]Passive Skill "Dragon Specter": Increases the character's Ignite DMG. When equipped by Behold! Fate-Defying Dragon and Astral Ring is activated, enemies take more Total DMG and all team members deal more Total DMG.[/p][p][/p][p]Synergy Skill "100% Win Rate": Enemies take more Total DMG from characters on the field (independent and exclusive). When equipped by Behold! Fate-Defying Dragon, enemies take more Fire DMG from her (independent).[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]◆ Recommended Stigma Set: Gaming for Life[/p][p]2-pc Bonus: Increases the character's Basic/Combo/Charged ATK's Total DMG. When equipped by Behold! Fate-Defying Dragon, enemies take more Ignite DMG from her and characters with Dragon's Prowess deal more Total DMG.[/p][p][/p][p]3-pc Bonus: The character's Ultimate deals more Fire DMG. When equipped by Behold! Fate-Defying Dragon and Astral Ring is activated, all team members gain Dragon's Prowess, she deals more Ignite DMG, and enemies take more Total DMG. When Law of Ascension is activated, enemies take more Elemental DMG and Physical DMG during Astral Ring Charging. In Stellar Outburst, enemies take more Elemental DMG, Physical DMG, and Total DMG. When Grail of Infinitude is activated, all team members deal more Physical DMG and enemies take more Elemental DMG, Physical DMG, and Total DMG during Astral Ring Charging. In Stellar Outburst, all team members deal even more Physical DMG, and enemies take even more Elemental DMG, Physical DMG, and Total DMG. When Rite of Oblivion is activated, all team members inflict more Ignite DMG and Bleed DMG. Enemies take more Elemental DMG and Physical DMG.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]◆ How to Get Equipment[/p][p]After the v8.4 update until 12:00, OCT 3, the recommended equipment for Behold! Fate-Defying Dragon, Rocket Hammer "Draconic Sky-Scorching Fury" and Gaming for Life stigma set, will be available in Equipment Supply. A 4★ weapon or stigma is guaranteed in every 10 Equipment Supply drops. You are guaranteed to get 4★ weapon "Draconic Sky-Scorching Fury" in 60 Equipment Supply drops.[/p][p][/p][p]After the v8.4 update until 04:00, OCT 23, participate in login events to get Gaming for Life Stigma Option x1. Open it to receive one of Behold! Fate-Defying Dragon's recommended stigmata. Gaming for Life stigma set will also be craftable. Forging a stigma requires Source Prism x2 and Ether Fuel x600.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]※ The above info is subject to change in the official release.[/p]

notes.title: Helia's new S-rank battlesuit "Planar Armament: Warped Spacetime" debuts!
notes.content: [p]Hello, Captain! Helia's new S-rank battlesuit "Planar Armament: Warped Spacetime" is debuting in v8.3! New Astral Ring Specialization: Grail of Infinitude will accompany her! Read on for more details![/p][p][/p][p]☆☆☆☆☆ Planar Armament: Warped Spacetime ☆☆☆☆☆[/p][p]She was once bound by seemingly unreachable dreams and entangled in vengeful obsession. Yet, she never abandoned the faith in her heart.[/p][p][/p][p]She measures an extraordinary path with ordinary steps, firmly toward the future she seeks. She stays true to her heart and her past self.[/p][p][/p][p]"We've come such a long way, Helia!"[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41350040/54b17e8127cb1d609158b6c1b508f7aa54c2ff70.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]◆ How to Get the Battlesuit[/p][p]After the v8.3 update until 12:00, AUG 8, Battlesuit Supply "Illuminated Path Ahead" will be available. The featured S-rank battlesuit "Planar Armament: Warped Spacetime" is guaranteed in 90 drops with 50% off the first 10 drops.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]☆☆☆☆☆ Skill Showcase ☆☆☆☆☆[/p][p]Planar Armament: Warped Spacetime is a BIO-type Lightning DMG dealer who wields a Rapid-Shot Crossbow. Now that Helia has confronted and accepted her true self, she continues to walk her own path and has unlocked new powers. She is protected by the Astral Ring Specialization: Grail of Infinitude. She has multiple ways to quickly recover SP, can deal burst damage by connecting Ultimate sequences, and can inflict Paralyze Trauma on enemies. During Stellar Outburst, the whole team shares SP, allowing you to synchronize SP recovery and damage dealing for lethal effects.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]◆ Ultimate: Prudence: Sincere Oath[/p][p]When SP is full, tap \[ULT] for "Planar Armament: Warped Spacetime" to perform her 3-sequence Ultimate. Each sequence grants 1 stack of KE "Scorch" and inflicts Paralyze Trauma on enemies.[/p][p][/p][p]After performing her Ultimate, she gains the buff "Floating Pivot". While the buff is in effect, some of her attacks will additionally release "Drifting Edge" to deal DMG while further accelerating SP recovery.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]◆ Combo ATK: Upright Form: Will to Advance[/p][p]When KE "Scorch" is full, hold \[ATK] to perform her Combo ATK that continuously pulls enemies, deals massive Lightning DMG, and triggers global Time Fracture. On hit, teammates' QTE are triggered.[/p][p][/p][p]During Stellar Outburst, Helia's Combo ATK can be connected to her Link Ultimate "Rainless Skies" to deal massive Lightning DMG. After that, she will exit Stellar Outburst. She will be invincible and Time-frozen Domain will take effect during this time.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]◆ Basic ATK: Upright Mind: Journey of Pursuit[/p][p]Tap \[ATK] to perform a 3-sequence Basic ATK and inflict Paralyze Trauma on enemies. While in mid-air, tap \[ATK] to perform a Downward ATK. Both Basic ATK and Downward ATK will restore SP to "Planar Armament: Warped Spacetime". While the buff "Floating Pivot" is in effect, Basic ATK will additionally release "Drifting Edge" and accelerate SP recovery.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]◆ Astral Ring Skill: Sky Arc Star: Homing Pigeon[/p][p]When "Planar Armament: Warped Spacetime" enters Stellar Outburst as the leader, her max SP increases and all team members share SP. During Stellar Outburst, she can consume a fixed amount of SP to trigger the special effect "Facet of Infinitude". After triggering "Facet of Infinitude" 2 times, her Combo ATK and Link Ultimate will be enhanced to deal even more Lightning DMG.[/p][p][/p][p]Teammates with the Symbiosis trait can accelerate SP recovery and "Facet of Infinitude" buildup, allowing the team to deal burst DMG at a faster rate.[/p][p][/p][p]In a Law of Ascension team, enter Stellar Outburst and select "Planar Armament: Warped Spacetime" to perform her powerful QTE "Stellar Shift", which triggers Combo ATK to deal Lightning DMG, and can be connected to Link Ultimate "Rainless Skies".[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]☆☆☆☆☆ Grail of Infinitude ☆☆☆☆☆[/p][p]Helia's new S-rank battlesuit "Planar Armament: Warped Spacetime" debuts with new Astral Ring Specialization: Grail of Infinitude.[/p][p][/p][p]◆ New Astral Ring Specialization: Grail of Infinitude[/p][p]When a character with Astral Ring Specialization: Grail of Infinitude activates the Astral Ring as the leader, all team members' max SP increases greatly and all team members share SP. The character can then deal continuous burst DMG by performing multiple Ultimates. Consuming a certain amount of SP triggers "Facet of Infinitude" to provide additional buffs to the team.[/p][p][/p][p]New battlesuit "Planar Armament: Warped Spacetime" is protected by Astral Ring Specialization: Grail of Infinitude. During Stellar Outburst, triggering "Facet of Infinitude" gradually increases her DMG dealt. Multiple triggers significantly enhances her Combo ATK.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]◆ New Astral Ring Trait: Symbiosis[/p][p]The new Astral Ring Specialization: Grail of Infinitude will unlock the new Astral Ring trait: Symbiosis for some characters.[/p][p][/p][p]When Astral Ring Specialization: Grail of Infinitude is activated, characters with the Astral Ring trait: Symbiosis will receive SP buffs, such as reduced SP consumption for Ultimates. During Stellar Outburst, these characters will restore bonus SP and accelerate "Facet of Infinitude" buildup, thus speeding up the team's burst DMG cycle.[/p][p][/p][p]During Stellar Outburst, the team's max SP is the sum of all team members' max SP. Some attacks of characters with the Symbiosis trait accelerate SP recovery. Use a character protected by Grail of Infinitude and activate Astral Ring to deal DMG. Then, switch to a character with the Symbiosis trait to attack and recover SP. Finally, switch back to the character protected by Grail of Infinitude to deal burst DMG.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]◆ New Astral Ring Skill Unlocked[/p][p]After the v8.3 update, "Peregrine Sword", "Ba-Dum! Fiery Wishing Star", "Herrscher of Human: Ego" (equipped with Flawless Benediction), and "Reign Solaris" will unlock the Astral Ring trait: Symbiosis and gain new Astral Ring skills. Please check them out on the respective battlesuit skill screens.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]☆☆☆☆☆ Key Rank-Up Skills ☆☆☆☆☆[/p][p]When she reaches S2, a new skill is unlocked and her sub-skill level cap is increased.[/p][p]"Planar Armament: Warped Spacetime" gains 1 extra Weapon Skill charge and 1 extra Ultimate Evasion Skill charge. When she is the leader, enemies on the field take more Total DMG from her. During Stellar Outburst, all team members deal more Lightning DMG after triggering "Facet of Infinitude".[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]When she reaches SS, a new skill is unlocked and her sub-skill level cap is increased.[/p][p]When she is the leader, during Astral Ring charging, her Ultimate no longer consumes SP when Astral Ring Intensity is full. She also deals more Total DMG to PSY-type enemies. During Astral Ring charging, when Astral Ring Intensity exceeds a certain amount, enemies on the field will take more Lightning DMG from her.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]☆☆☆☆☆ Recommended Equipment ☆☆☆☆☆[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41350040/94b901ba920b27b22fa35a96edabfc313f7c8047.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]◆ Recommended Weapon: Rainbow From Cinders[/p][p]Active Skill "Arrowing Will": The weapon active's CD, max charges, and effects are based on the wielder's type. If the wielder has the Symbiosis trait, she deals more Lightning DMG. When equipped by Planar Armament: Warped Spacetime and she enters Stellar Outburst as the leader, her initial SP increases based on her max SP. After performing Condensed Thunder, Time-frozen Domain takes effect.[/p][p][/p][p]Passive Skill "Shooting Stars After Rain": Increases Total DMG. When equipped by Planar Armament: Warped Spacetime, all team members deal more Elemental DMG and Physical DMG. When Astral Ring is activated, she deals more Lightning DMG and all team members deal more Total DMG.[/p][p][/p][p]Synergy Skill "Enduring Conviction": Enemies take more Total DMG from characters on the field (independent and exclusive). When equipped by Planar Armament: Warped Spacetime, enemies take more Lightning DMG from her (independent).[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]◆ Recommended Stigma Set: Choices of Fate[/p][p]2-pc Bonus: Increases Lightning DMG. When equipped by Planar Armament: Warped Spacetime, enemies take more Lightning DMG from her. When Astral Ring is activated, enemies take more Elemental DMG from characters with "Raise the Banner". When Law of Ascension is activated, all team members deal more Total DMG. Enemies take more Total DMG, Elemental DMG, and Physical DMG from characters with "Raise the Banner" and more Total DMG from her.[/p][p][/p][p]3-pc Bonus: Increases Total DMG of Ultimate and Combo ATK. When equipped by Planar Armament: Warped Spacetime, all team members gain "Raise the Banner" when Ultimate or QTE hit enemies and she enters Stellar Outburst or when she enters the battle as the leader. When "Grail of Infinitude" is activated, all team members with "Raise the Banner" deal more Total DMG, Elemental DMG, and Physical DMG. All team members with "Raise the Banner" and the Symbiosis trait deal more Total DMG. When she is not the leader, all enemies take more Total DMG and Physical DMG from characters with "Raise the Banner". During Stellar Outburst, all enemies take more Total DMG, Elemental DMG, and Physical DMG from characters with "Raise the Banner" and the Symbiosis trait.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]◆ How to Get Equipment[/p][p]After the v8.3 update until 12:00, AUG 8, the recommended equipment for "Planar Armament: Warped Spacetime", "Rainbow From Cinders" and "Choices of Fate" stigma set, will be available in Equipment Supply. A 4★weapon or stigma is guaranteed in every 10 Equipment Supply drops. You are guaranteed to get 4★weapon "Rainbow From Cinders" in 60 Equipment Supply drops.[/p][p][/p][p]After the v8.3 update until 04:00, AUG 21, participate in the login event to get Choices of Fate Stigma Option x1. Open the Choices of Fate Stigma Option to receive one of Planar Armament: Warped Spacetime's recommended stigmata. Choices of Fate stigma set will also be craftable. Forging a stigma requires Source Prism x2 and Ether Fuel x600.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]※ The above info is subject to change in the official release.[/p]

notes.title: Snazzy Cards Championship
notes.content:
Pack your bags and grab your partners! The grand Snazzy Cards Championship begins!

Snazzy Cards Championship is now live! Collect and upgrade Snazzy Cards in the event to build decks for challenges. Play the event to claim Azure Silhouette Outfit Option, Snazzy Victor Emblem, Crystals, Source Prisms and more.

Snazzy Cards Championship
Time: 10:00, MAY 15 ~ 04:00, JUN 26

Required Level: 30 or higher

Details
1. During the event, collect cards and build teams decks to clear various challenge stages. Once the fight begins, cards will automatically engage in combat. When specific conditions are met, tap the card avatars at the bottom of the screen to cast Ultimate or support skills. There are also buttons at the bottom right of the screen to double the combat speed and automatically cast skills.

2. Clear specific stages to obtain Ai-chan Energice, Cardcha Lid: Type-α, and Cardcha Lid: Type-β. These three items can be consumed in Cardcha Encounter to obtain Snazzy Cards.

3. The event features four types of challenge stages: Interstellar Paper Fiesta, Ladder Challenge, Rigorous Showdown, and Special Trial. Complete specific Interstellar Paper Fiesta stages to unlock other challenge types. Earn 2000 points in Rigorous Showdown to obtain the Snazzy Victor Emblem. The emblem records your highest score in this event.

4. After completing the first stage of Interstellar Paper Fiesta, Snazzy EXP and other rewards will be automatically accumulated based on minutes spent AFK. Tap the bottom right button on the event page to claim available rewards after your last claim. Completing more objectives in Interstellar Paper Fiesta grants better rewards for each minute spent AFK.


Ding-Dong Grocery Store
Irresistible fun and tough battles that never stop - this is the true meaning of Snazzy Cards!

Time: 10:00, MAY 15 ~ 04:00, JUL 3

Required Level: 30 or higher

Event Rewards
Play the event to earn Buzzing Chips, which can be used in the event shop Ding-Dong Grocery Store to exchange for Azure Silhouette Outfit Option, Crystals, Source Prisms, Honkai Shards and more.

*Open Azure Silhouette Outfit Option to choose from one of the following: outfit Immortal Blades Uniform, outfit Verdant Sky, outfit Orochi Cuirass, or 8000 Asterite.


*Ai-chan's Reminders:
1. You can obtain enough Buzzing Chips from the event to exchange for all the rewards in the event shop.

2. Buzzing Chips will expire at 04:00, JUL 3 and return 370 Coins each.

Yunchin's Culinary Wonders
Time
After the v8.2 update ~ 04:00, JUN 26

2. Each business day is divided into preparation, operation, and closing hours. During closing hours, gather new ingredients and gain inspiration for new dishes through roving. You can only conduct roving once on each business day. Each day's roving grants a limited amount of ingredients. You may want to prioritize ingredients required by missions or favored by customers the next day.

3. While roving, new characters, ingredients, and encounters can be unlocked. Their unlocking depends on the characters deployed for roving and the ingredients prioritized. Check the criteria to unlock various content on the Roving Journal page.

Eat all you can with Chow.

★ New BIO-type S-rank Battlesuit Peregrine Sword
Peregrine Sword is a BIO-type Physical DMG dealer who wields Fists and is protected by Astral Ring Specialization: Law of Ascension. A wandering swordswoman must have a weapon in hand; with a bamboo umbrella that conceals a sword by her side, she can execute versatile Joint ATKs. notes.title: Li Sushang's new S-rank battlesuit Peregrine Sword debuts!
notes.content:
Life is for wandering, and food is for savoring. There's nothing a good meal can't solve—and if there is, have another one!

☆☆☆☆☆ Peregrine Sword ☆☆☆☆☆
Word has it that Li Sushang, the wandering swordswoman in Shenzhou, has made a new friend.

This friend is quite a peculiar character—it's a Jingwei that travels with cooking utensils on its back! Oh, and it has a unique name: Chow.

Here's the story. Back in the day, a starving Sushang was amazed by Chow's cooking, so she decided to travel with it. From then on, a human and a Jingwei, a sword and a wok, have been inseparable. Together, they roam Shenzhou, fighting any monsters and cooking any ingredients they come across!

As for whether this tale is true or false... Well, Sushang is currently eating her way through Yunchin, so you can ask her about it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41350040/91c52ef60e12f63fd0ea2e66129dd883e3431d92.png[/img]


◆ How to Get the Battlesuit
After the v8.2 update until 12:00, JUN 6, the Battlesuit Supply 'A Tasting Sword' will be available. You're more likely to obtain Peregrine Sword with 50% off the first 10 drops in this Battlesuit Supply.



☆☆☆☆☆ Skill Showcase ☆☆☆☆☆
Peregrine Sword is a BIO-type Physical DMG dealer who wields Fists. A wandering swordswoman must have a weapon in hand. With a bamboo umbrella that conceals a sword by her side, she can execute versatile combos. Be careful, you'll bleed if you bump into this umbrella!


◆ Basic ATK: Sour, Taste of Innocence
Sushang leaps upward, uses momentum to flip, and slashes downward.

Perform a 4-sequence Basic ATK on the ground, dealing Physical DMG while inflicting Bleed Trauma on hit enemies. Then tap [Weapon] to cast Li Sushang's Joint Weapon Skill 'Forest Piercer'.


◆ Weapon Skill: Winds Carry My Will
Tap [Weapon] to make Li Sushang toss her bamboo umbrella and inflict Bleed Trauma on enemies. Tap [Weapon] again to cast Forest Piercer.

After entering via QTE, Weapon Skill CD is reset and Weapon Skill is automatically cast, inflicting Bleed Trauma on hit enemies. Tap [Weapon] again to cast Forest Piercer. When she is equipped with the recommended weapon Jadeite Sleeves or Jadeite Sleeves: Windward, her kills increase Bleed Trauma and reset Weapon Skill CD.


◆ Combo ATK: Sweet, Taste of Justice
When enemies are hit by Basic ATK, Weapon Skill, or Forest Piercer, she gains KE 'Sword Force'. Sword Force has four tiers: Initiation, Elevation, Transition, and Conclusion. When KE is full, hold [ATK] to perform a Combo ATK that deals Physical DMG and inflicts Bleed Trauma on hit enemies.

After performing Combo ATK, tap [Weapon] to cast Joint ATK 'Swaying with Wind and Rain' and deal massive Physical DMG. When her combo exceeds 50 hits, she deals more Physical DMG. More combo hits mean more DMG dealt.


◆ Ultimate: Spicy, Taste of Ambition
When Ultimate is cast, Li Sushang is undaunted by rain or sun as she travels across mountains and rivers. She stands amidst a bamboo grove, unleashing razor-sharp slashes on all enemies, dealing massive Physical DMG.

During her Ultimate, she is invincible and Time-frozen Domain will be in effect.


◆ Astral Ring Skill: Past Swept Away By Bamboo Breeze
When Peregrine Sword is the leader, activate Astral Ring Specialization: Law of Ascension and enter Stellar Outburst. Then, select Peregrine Sword to skim across a lotus pond and slash away in a bamboo grove; her Stellar Shift also inflicts Bleed Trauma on hit enemies.

When she is the leader, tap [Weapon] to perform all Joint ATKs in succession. When she isn't the leader, tap [Weapon] to perform Joint ATK 'Leaf Sweep'.



☆☆☆☆☆ Key Rank-Up Skills ☆☆☆☆☆
When she reaches S1, her sub-skill level cap is increased.
Enemies take more Bleed DMG from her and more Total DMG from all team members.


When she reaches S2, a new skill is unlocked.
When casting Joint ATK 'Forest Piercer', Ultimate Evasion Skill is also triggered.


When she reaches SS, a new skill is unlocked and her sub-skill level cap is increased.
Joint ATK 'Swaying with Wind and Rain' deals more Total DMG. A new skill is unlocked and all Joint ATKs deal more Total DMG.


When she reaches SSS, her sub-skill level cap is increased.
Every hit from any of her attacks increases DMG dealt to Hit Shields.



☆☆☆☆☆ Recommended Equipment ☆☆☆☆☆

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41350040/06896c57b4c66333ef41e1d374a81ca1a6dc53ef.png[/img]


◆ Jadeite Sleeves
Active Skill 'Entrancing Mountains': The weapon active skill effects are based on the wielder's type. A wielder with the Heavenly Shift trait deals more Physical DMG. When equipped by Peregrine Sword: During Stellar Shift, tapping the QTE button charges follow-up attacks to deal more Physical DMG. When Basic ATK hits enemies, Bleed Trauma is inflicted faster.

Passive Skill 'Affectionate Rivers': Increases Bleed DMG. When equipped by Peregrine Sword, Weapon Skill CD is reset when an enemy's HP is reduced to 0. When Astral Ring is activated, she deals more Physical DMG and her teammates deal more Total DMG.

Synergy Skill 'Carefree Wanderer': Enemies take more Total DMG from characters on the field (independent and exclusive). When equipped by Peregrine Sword, enemies take more Physical DMG from her (independent).


◆ Newfound Joys Stigma Set

3-pc Bonus: Enemies take more Total DMG and Physical DMG from the wielder. When equipped by Peregrine Sword, she inflicts more Bleed Trauma. After hitting enemies with QTE or Weapon Skill and then entering Stellar Outburst or entering battle as the leader, all team members gain World is My Oyster. When Law of Ascension is activated, all enemies on the field are impaired. Characters with World is My Oyster deal more Elemental DMG and Total DMG. In Stellar Outburst, characters with World is My Oyster deal more Total DMG, Elemental DMG, and Physical DMG. When Peregrine Sword is the leader and there are Physical DMG dealers on her team, she deals more Bleed DMG.


◆ How to Get Equipment

notes.title: Kiana's new S-rank battlesuit Ba-Dum! Fiery Wishing Star debuts!
notes.content:
Kiana's new S-rank battlesuit Ba-Dum! Fiery Wishing Star debuts in v8.1! Read on for more details!

☆☆☆☆☆ Ba-Dum! Fiery Wishing Star ☆☆☆☆☆
Journey through dreams joyfully and with resolute determination to the beat of drums!

Kiana embarks on a new adventure with the hope of making everyone happy. This journey will be arduous and unpredictable, but she's quick on her feet and can use her wits to resolve any problems. Her current appearance is how others imagine the Spring Festival messenger to be. Through cheers and blessings during the celebratory performance, this envisioned image is conveyed to Kiana.

It's not fortune that blesses everything. Perhaps, it's a passionate and sincere heart that has been guiding her since the beginning.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41350040/63974d7d020e5aa981d39c9b992ea890b8cec228.png[/img]


◆ How to Get the Battlesuit
After the v8.1 update ~ 12:00, APR 4, the Battlesuit Supply Wishes Made Tonight will be available. The featured S-rank battlesuit Ba-Dum! Fiery Wishing Star is guaranteed in 90 drops with 50% off the first 10 drops.


☆☆☆☆☆ Skill Showcase ☆☆☆☆☆
Ba-Dum! Fiery Wishing Star is an SD-type Fire DMG dealer who fights with pistols. On the battlefield, she wields a long staff and takes the stage with Rice Cake! As the Spring Festival's messenger, Kiana battles single or multiple enemies in a festive manner. You will hear "Ba-dum→ Ba-dum ba-dum↗ Ba-dum" as monsters are knocked unconscious and sent to dreamland to have sweet dreams.

◆ Basic ATK: High Hopes Engraved by the Past
Ba-Dum! Fiery Wishing Star can perform a 4-sequence Basic ATK against enemies on the ground or in the air, dealing Fire DMG and marking enemies with Passion Marks. Evading and jumping will not reset Basic ATK combo hits.


◆ Combo ATK: Final Wishes Reflected by Journeys
Hold [ATK] on the ground or in the air to cast Combo ATK and knock enemies airborne or knock down enemies while dealing Fire DMG. Enemies will also be pulled in and marked with Passion Marks.
When an enemy is hit by Combo ATK or Stellar Shift (powerful entry skill), they take more Total DMG from Ba-Dum! Fiery Wishing Star's Weapon Skill and Ultimate. If more than one enemy is on the field, this effect is temporarily disabled.


◆ Weapon Skill: Fiery Passion Forged by the Earthly
Tap [Weapon] for Ba-Dum! Fiery Wishing Star to mark enemies with Passion Marks and spread Passion Marks to enemies that have not been hit. When Basic ATK, Weapon Skill, and Combo ATK hit enemies, her KE, Fortune, will be restored. When KE is maxed out, tap [Weapon] to cast Special Weapon Skill Immaculate Duet! This attack will detonate all Passion Marks and deal bonus DMG to enemies in the range. Weapon Skill, Special Weapon Skill, and Stellar Shift (powerful entry skill) can link up to 6 enemies hit, causing them to take on a certain ratio of DMG inflicted on each other. Battling multiple enemies will be even more efficient now.

*On the skill screen, configure how to cast Special Weapon Skill by either tapping or holding [Weapon].


◆ Ultimate: Fantastical Dreams Adorned by Love
In the midst of countless dazzling lanterns, Kiana raises a long staff enveloped in blazing flames. In hopes of showering blessings on everyone, she strikes the majestic drum to beckon good fortune and deals massive Fire DMG while restoring HP for all team members. During her Ultimate, she is invincible and triggers Time-frozen Domain.


◆ Astral Ring Skill: Lucky Star, Time to Feast!
When Ba-Dum! Fiery Wishing Star is the leader, Astral Ring Specialization: Law of Ascension is activated, and she can cast Stellar Shift (powerful entry skill) when entering Stellar Outburst to deal DMG. Tap [ATK] while following the button prompts on the screen and make Ba-Dum! Fiery Wishing Star play the drums rapidly. She will deal multiple sequences of DMG and mark enemies with Passion Marks. She will also enter the Augmented Ascension state. Switch to team members with the Heavenly Shift trait to trigger their Stellar Shift.


☆☆☆☆☆ Key Rank-Up Skills ☆☆☆☆☆
When she reaches S2, a new skill is unlocked and her sub-skill level cap is increased.
Casting Combo ATK, Weapon Skill, and the Basic ATK SEQ 4 will trigger her Ultimate Evasion Skill. Up to 6 enemies hit by Stellar Shift, Weapon Skill, and Special Weapon Skill can be linked. The ratio of transferred DMG taken from Ba-Dum! Fiery Wishing Star and her team members increases.

When she reaches SS, a new skill is unlocked and her sub-skill level cap is increased.
QTE entry restores more KE and SP. The DMG transfer ratio of linked enemies is further increased.

When she reaches SSS, a new skill is unlocked.
After casting QTE and Stellar Shift, her Ultimate Evasion Skill CD is reset.


☆☆☆☆☆ Recommended Equipment ☆☆☆☆☆

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41350040/8888b0a3fac54f91f805de1164d98a159d0c3b61.png[/img]


◆ Fortuitous Red
Active Skill Greetings of Flames and Drums: Weapon active's CD, charging time, and skill effects are determined by the wielder's type. If the wielder has the Heavenly Shift trait, the wielder deals more Fire DMG. Ba-Dum! Fiery Wishing Star equip bonus: After she casts Stellar Shift as the leader, she triggers Time-frozen Domain for a certain duration. Casting Ultimate or switching to another teammate will end Time-frozen Domain immediately. During Merriment after Stellar Shift is cast, her Basic ATKs deal more Total DMG. During Stellar Shift, each hit of the drum deals bonus Fire DMG. When there is only one enemy on the field, one additional Passion Mark can be inflicted. Passion Marks detonated by Immaculate Duet deal bonus Fire DMG.

Passive Skill Blessings of Stars and Night: Increases Total DMG. When equipped by Ba-Dum! Fiery Wishing Star, Resonance from all team members deals more Elemental DMG. When Astral Ring is activated, she deals more Fire DMG and her team members deal more Total DMG.

Synergy Skill Harmonious Melody, Resounding Drums: Enemies take more Total DMG from characters on the field (independent and exclusive). When equipped by Ba-Dum! Fiery Wishing Star, enemies take more Fire DMG from her (independent).


◆ Happy Days Ahead Stigma Set
2-pc Bonus: Increases Fire DMG. When equipped by Ba-Dum! Fiery Wishing Star, enemies take more Fire DMG from her. When Astral Ring is activated, enemies take more Physical DMG and Elemental DMG from characters with Let's Have Fun!. When World Star is activated and during Astral Ring Charging, all team members deal more Total DMG. When World Star is activated and during Stellar Outburst, enemies take more Elemental DMG and Total DMG from characters with Let's Have Fun! and more Total DMG from Weapon Skills and Combo ATKs.

3-pc Bonus: Increases Total DMG. When equipped by Ba-Dum! Fiery Wishing Star, all team members gain Let's Have Fun! when Combo ATK or QTE hit enemies, and when she enters Stellar Outburst or enters the battle as the leader. Retriggering refreshes the duration. Enemies take more Total DMG from her. When Law of Ascension is activated, characters with Let's Have Fun! deal more Elemental DMG, Physical DMG, and Total DMG. Enemies take more Total DMG from characters with Let's Have Fun!. In Stellar Outburst, enemies take more Total DMG, Elemental DMG, and Physical DMG from characters with Let's Have Fun!.


◆ How to Get Equipment
After the v8.1 update ~ 12:00, APR 4, the recommended equipment for Ba-Dum! Fiery Wishing Star, Pistols Fortuitous Red and Happy Days Ahead stigma set, will be available in Equipment Supply. A 4★ weapon or stigma is guaranteed in every 10 Equipment Supply drops. You are guaranteed to get 4★ weapon Fortuitous Red in 60 Equipment Supply drops.

After the v8.1 update ~ 04:00, APR 24, participate in the login event to get Happy Days Ahead Stigma Option x1. Open it to receive one of Ba-Dum! Fiery Wishing Star's recommended stigmata. Happy Days Ahead stigma set will also be craftable. Forging a stigma requires Source Prism x2 and Ether Fuel x600.


※ The above info is subject to change in the official release.

notes.title: Countdown: To Sweet Dreams! | Play to get a new outfit, Crystals, and more!
notes.content:
How many wishes are in this fantastical journey? The young lady traverses many dreams in search of answers.

Featured event Countdown: To Sweet Dreams! begins! Command monster followers with Kiana and restore peace to New Year's Land! Play the event to obtain Deepspace Anchor: First Light's new outfit Steering Inequations, Crystals, Source Prisms, Honkai Shards and more!


===== Countdown: To Sweet Dreams! =====

Time
10:00, JAN 16 ~ 04:00, FEB 20

*This event will be permanent after the v8.1 update. Some content and rewards are limited to v8.0, so don't miss out!

Required Level: 30 or higher

Details
1. This event has four chapters. Each chapter unlocks a Leader Follower of a specific style and its corresponding Support Follower. Collect a specific number of followers to obtain Global Skills, Crystals, and Source Prisms.

The schedule for each chapter and unlockable style is as follows:
Chapter 1: 10:00, JAN 16. Unlocks Mixed Elemental style - Benares: Spring Festival's Eve Form.
Chapter 2: 10:00, JAN 18. Unlocks Blade Counterattack style - Husk: Festivalism.
Chapter 3: 10:00, JAN 20. Unlocks Air Raid Suppression style - Signet of Past Deliverance: Welcoming the New.
Chapter 4: 10:00, JAN 22. Unlocks Spacetime Manipulation style - Alien Visitor: Blooming with Prosperity.

2. Clearing stage 1-3 unlocks Beckoning Fortune stages. Spend Kiki's Blessing Pack to clear Beckoning Fortune stages and obtain growth materials to level up Leader Followers and reset Support Follower affixes. Clear 3★ challenges of the stages to unlock the sweep function and obtain growth materials quickly.

Kiki's Blessing Pack x2 will be issued every day. Captains can store up to Kiki's Blessing Pack x4.

3. Clearing stage 1-6 unlocks Spring Festival Challenge stages. Clear 24 3★ challenges to obtain Slice of Success Emblem, on which you can see the total score of all four Final Test stages.


===== Spring Festival Gift Shop =====

It's not even the Spring Festival yet, but I'm already itching to shop for the necessities!

Time: 10:00, JAN 16 ~ 04:00, FEB 27

Required Level: 30 or higher

Event Rewards
Play the event to earn Wishing Packs, which can be used in the event shop Spring Festival Gift Shop to exchange for Deepspace Anchor: First Light's new outfit Steering Inequations, Crystals, Source Prisms, Honkai Shards and more.


*Ai-chan's Reminders:
1. You can obtain enough Wishing Packs from the event to exchange for all the rewards in the event shop.

2. 04:00, FEB 20 ~ 04:00, FEB 27, every 20 Wishing Packs can be purchased with 20 Crystals in Spring Festival Gift Shop. Limited to 99 purchases per Captain.

3. Wishing Packs will expire at 04:00, FEB 27 and return 840 Coins each.

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41350040/93697d550ccf314ae36b9ce01b5c565f76be29b0.jpg[/img]


=====Shiny and Sparkling=====

Shiny and Sparkling coming soon! Complete Part 2 Main Story Chapter V to the latest Chapter VII in v8.0 to be eligible for the prize pool of 60 million Crystals shared across all servers (Traditional Chinese/JP/KR/SEA/Europe & Americas servers).

Time
After the v8.0 update ~ 04:00, FEB 20


Required Level
30 or higher


Details
1. During the event, complete Part 2 Main Story Chapters V to VII to become eligible.

2. In this event, a total of 60 million Crystals will be split among eligible Captains from all servers (Traditional Chinese/JP/KR/SEA/Europe & Americas servers).

3. The number of Crystals each eligible Captain receives will be randomly chosen, starting from a minimum of 400 Crystals.

*For more details on the rules, please visit the Shiny and Sparkling event page.


Time
Participation: After the v8.0 update ~ 03:59, JAN 30, 2025
Prize Validity: 12:00, JAN 30, 2025 ~ 04:00, FEB 20, 2025


*Ai-chan's Reminder:
After completing all missions, please head to the Shiny and Sparkling event page and tap the button to participate on the Crystal Chest before 03:59, JAN 30. Doing so will make you eligible for the prize pool!


=====Treasure Hunt Celebration=====

Treasure Hunt Celebration will also be available. Complete missions on the event page to obtain Treasure Finder Tickets. Each Treasure Finder Ticket can be used to explore any prize once. After the event ends, Captains will stand a chance to win prizes they explored for. Play the event to win a figurine, Radiant Luxury Option, Paladin BP Unlock Coupon, Crystals and more.

Time
After the v8.0 update ~ 04:00, FEB 20


Required Level
30 or higher


Details
1. During the event, complete missions on the Gold Rush page to obtain Treasure Finder Tickets and participate in merch raffles to win Elysia figurine, Radiant Luxury Option, Revered Starlight Option, Paladin BP Unlock Coupon, Crystals and other merch/in-game rewards!

2. Spend Treasure Finder Tickets to explore for any prize once. Once the exploration period ends, random Captains who have explored the prizes will be selected to win them.

3. You can only win each prize once, but you can win different prizes simultaneously. The more you explore, the higher your chances of winning. Please use the Treasure Finder Tickets wisely.

4. Regardless of who wins, all Captains can claim 10 Crystals for every exploration made.


Event Rewards
1. Elysia Figurine
Elysia: Miss Pink♪ 1/7 Scale Figurine x1

2. Radiant Luxury Option
Contains Radiant Luxury Option and Gear PRI Crate.

Open Radiant Luxury Option to choose from one of the following: Splendid Universe Option: Deepspace Anchor: First Light, Splendid Universe Option: Mad Pleasure: Shadowbringer, Splendid Universe Option: Lone Destruction: Shadowchaser, or Splendid Universe Option: Jovial Deception: Shadowdimmer. You will obtain the corresponding Character Card x1, recommended non-PRI-ARM weapon of the battlesuit at max level x1, recommended stigma set of the battlesuit at max level x1, and Battlesuit Supply Card x10.

Open Gear PRI Crate to get Einstein's Torus x400, SC Metal-H2 x520, and Fluid Alloy Block x45.

3. Revered Starlight Option
Open to choose from one of the following: Deepspace Anchor: First Light Character Card, Mad Pleasure: Shadowbringer Character Card, Lone Destruction: Shadowchaser Character Card, or Jovial Deception: Shadowdimmer Character Card.

4. Piercing Brilliance Option
Open to choose from one of the following weapons: Red Star Thunderbolt, Banquet Rose, Burn the Long Night, or Purge of Ten Faces.

5. Paladin BP Unlock Coupon
Use it to upgrade the current BP season to Paladin BP.

6. Reroll Device: ATK Option
Use it to select one Reroll Device: ATK of any type.

7. Crystals
100 Crystals


Raffle Time
Participation: After the v8.0 update ~ 11:59, JAN 30

Prize Validity: 12:00, JAN 30 ~ 04:00, FEB 20


*Ai-chan's Reminder:
Captains who have won merch prizes should submit their addresses before 04:00, MAR 10!

notes.title: v8.0 In Search of the Sun Update Announcement
notes.content:
Welcome to v8.0: In Search of the Sun!


Update Content
★ New IMG-type S-rank Battlesuit Reign Solaris
Reign Solaris is an IMG-type Physical DMG dealer. Nimble and agile, she rides a hoverboard to zip past enemies. Her javelin pierces enemies like a streaking bolt of light as she dominates the battlefield. She is protected by Astral Ring Specialization: Law of Ascension. After she enters Stellar Outburst, she automatically casts an enhanced entry attack the next time she is switched in.

*You can obtain the new battlesuit and her recommended equipment in the following ways:
1. Solar Radiance Battlesuit Supply is available. The featured S-rank battlesuit Reign Solaris is guaranteed in 90 drops with 50% off the first 10 drops.

2. Equipment Supply is available for a limited time. Recommended for Reign Solaris: Javelin Valorous Effulgence and Illuminating the Universe stigma set drop rates UP!

3. Glowing Sun and Stars login event begins. Log in for 7 days to obtain Illuminating the Universe Stigma Option x1, 120 Crystals, and more. Open Illuminating the Universe Stigma Option to choose from one of Reign Solaris's recommended stigmata.

4. Illuminating the Universe stigma set is craftable. Forging a stigma requires Source Prism x2 and Ether Fuel x600.


★ Part 2 Chapter VII: Bouquets of Unfulfilled Wishes
I offer you a final sunset and a stagnant sky; I offer you a bouquet of mottled memories and a starry sky of silence.

New main story Bouquets of Unfulfilled Wishes begins. Play the main story and event Clean-up Masters On Duty! to get Crystals, Source Prisms, Ancient Willpowers, and more.


★ Bonuses Events Shiny and Sparkling and Treasure Hunt Celebration
During the events, play the new version and complete event missions for a share from a generous pool of Crystals. Get chances to participate in raffles for a character figurine, selected S-rank battlesuits, max level recommended equipment, Paladin BP Unlock Coupon, Crystals, and more!


★ Featured Event Countdown: To Sweet Dreams!
Rice Cake, master of New Year's Land, will assist Kiana as she obtains the power to command monsters. She will transform into her monster followers and fight. Play the event to get Deepspace Anchor: First Light's new outfit Steering Inequations, Crystals, Source Prisms, Honkai Shards, and more.


★ Hyperion Arsenal
New weapons: Valorous Effulgence and PRI-ARM Valorous Effulgence: New Voyage.

New stigmata: Illuminating the Universe stigma set.



Game Adjustments & Optimizations
☆☆☆☆☆ Battlesuits ☆☆☆☆☆
The following data are at max skill level:
◆ Thousand-Faced Maestro: Cameo!
1. Fixed an issue in some stages where the lighting sometimes glitched on the finalization screen for her.

2. Fixed an issue where she sometimes glitched and could cast Ultimate Temp Lead on fallen teammates.

3. Fixed an issue during combat against boss Dominator of Wolves where she sometimes glitched when casting Combo ATK I Am Elation!.

4. Fixed an issue where some special effects sometimes glitched after Thousand-Faced Maestro: Cameo! cast Ultimate Thousand-Faced Fool, when Fenghuang of Vicissitude was in the Crane of Taixuan outfit.

5. Fixed an issue where the effect "Quantum Collapse effect of Spectacular Support will be triggered for another time" in active skills Wonderous Game and Extravagant Mischief sometimes activated abnormally when she was equipped with Volatile Sparkler or Volatile Sparkler: Floral Spectacle.

6. Fixed an issue on the Valkyrie screen where her character model's skirt sometimes glitched when she was in the Fictitious Game outfit.

7. Fixed an issue where the display of Quantum Mech Energy for her sometimes glitched.


◆ Jovial Deception: Shadowdimmer
Fixed an issue in Part 2 Main Story's map where the lighting sometimes glitched when Jovial Deception: Shadowdimmer cast Ultimate.


◆ Deepspace Anchor: First Light
Fixed an issue where Deepspace Anchor: First Light's movements sometimes glitched when she was in some sandbox scenes.


◆ Fenghuang of Vicissitude
Fixed an issue where she sometimes fell out of the map after casting Ultimate.


◆ Herrscher of Finality
1. Fixed an issue where she glitched and sometimes could not jump.

2. Fixed an issue where her facial expressions sometimes glitched when she casts Ultimate Go Kiana! when she is equipped with her recommended weapons Waxing Moon or Waxing Moon: Incipience.


◆ Herrscher of Flamescion
Fixed an issue where the special effects of her cloak sometimes glitched.


◆ Others
Unlocked Astral Ring skills corresponding to the Heavenly Shift trait for Jovial Deception: Shadowdimmer, Lone Planetfarer, and Thousand-Faced Maestro: Cameo!.



☆☆☆☆☆ Weapons ☆☆☆☆☆
◆ Waxing Moon and Waxing Moon: Incipience
Improved weapon text descriptions. This is only a text correction, and it does not affect the actual effects.



☆☆☆☆☆ AstralOps ☆☆☆☆☆
◆ Serapeum
Fixed an issue where the effect "When World Star is activated, the character recovers Astral Ring Intensity by releasing Resonance attacks" from her Recharge Skill A Heart for Lya sometimes glitched and failed to trigger.


◆ Others
Fixed an issue where AstralOp bridge interactions sometimes glitched and failed to be triggered.



☆☆☆☆☆ Gameplay ☆☆☆☆☆
◆ Part 2 Main Story
1. Added main story map: Tower of Ruimu: God's Residence that can be unlocked through Part 2 Main Story Chapter VII missions.

2. Fixed an issue in Excavate? Pursuit? Big Winner! where the red dot indicator sometimes glitched and displayed abnormally.

3. Fixed an issue in the main story where the rendering of Coralie's hair color sometimes glitched on some Android devices.

4. Fixed an issue in the main story where the rendering of some characters' facial lighting sometimes glitched on some Android devices.

5. Fixed an issue in the main story where scene lighting sometimes glitched on some Android devices.

6. Fixed an issue in Main Story Chapters I to III where the achievement Piercing Water could not be completed.

7. Fixed an issue in Main Story Chapters I to III where the screen sometimes turned black for some missions.

8. Fixed an issue where the model of boss Perception in Boss Review sometimes glitched and was wrongly positioned during combat.

9. Optimized some NPC animations in the main story map: Ruimu.


◆ Part 1 Main Story
1. Fixed an issue in Main Story Chapters XXIX ~ XXXI where the stage Data Storm sometimes glitched and did not start when no ELFs were deployed.

2. Fixed an issue in Main Story Chapter XVIII where characters sometimes fell out of the scene.


◆ Open World
Fixed an issue in APHO Chapter 2 where adventure tasks and activated maps were sometimes mismatched.


◆ Superstring Dimension
1. New stage: Bloodbane: Perilous, featuring Bygone Deliverance as the main enemy.

2. New stage: Inferno: Perilous, featuring Tonatiuh: Sunshade as the main enemy.

3. New stage: Shift: Perilous, featuring Meteor: Manifestation of Mockery and Frost Emperor as the main enemies.

4. Adjusted the max HP of Husk-Noumenon and Otto Apocalypse in Bloodbane: Perilous.

5. Adjusted the max HP of Husk-Noumenon in Bloodbane: Perilous.

6. Adjusted the max HP of Flame-Chaser: Aponia in Dominance: Perilous.

7. Adjusted the max HP of Frost Emperor in Shift: Perilous.

8. Adjusted the max HP of Hellmaru in Symphony: Perilous.

9. Adjusted the max HP of MHT-3C Retaliator in Shadow: Perilous.

10. Adjusted some weather stats as follows:
Stellar Environment: During Stellar Outburst, bonus Total DMG dealt by all teammates increased from 10% to 20%. Other effects remain unchanged.

Starless Environment: When the Astral Ring system is not activated, bonus Total DMG dealt by all teammates increased from 30% to 50%. Other effects remain unchanged.

Shadow Environment: When Shadow Star Attack hits enemies, bonus Total DMG dealt by the battlesuit on the field increased from 30% to 50%. Other effects remain unchanged.

Echoing Environment: For every teammate with the Domain Resonance trait, bonus Total DMG dealt by all teammates increased from 5% to 10%. When World Star is activated, bonus Total DMG dealt by all teammates increased from 30% to 40%.

Stellar Crown Environment: For every teammate with the Omniscient Star trait, bonus Total DMG dealt by all teammates increased from 8% to 10%. When Rite of Oblivion is activated, bonus Total DMG dealt by all teammates increased from 30% to 40%.


◆ Memorial Arena
1. New C~SS boss: Kevin Kaslana and SSS boss: Bygone Deliverance

2. Fixed an issue where characters sometimes glitched and failed to deflect Vita's Wheel when bringing ELF Kiana Kaslana to the battle against SSS-rank Boss Vita: Sea's Depths.

3. Fixed an issue where Valkyrie Quicksand's Ultimate One Thousand and One Fantasies sometimes glitched and was interrupted during the battle against C~SS-rank Boss Vita: Sea's Depths.

4. Fixed an issue with SSS-rank Boss Vita: Sea's Depths's initial phase where battlesuits sometimes glitched when deflecting Vita's Wheel and failed to restore SP.

5. Fixed an issue where SSS-rank boss Valrahal was sometimes abnormally hit by Stygian Nymph's Ultimate during phase change.


◆ Elysian Realm
1. New playable battlesuit: Reign Solaris

2. Updated the stage effects and buff effects of Deep Sequence.

3. The replaceable boss for Floor 17 of Deep Sequence is now HoD Minion.

4. Adjusted some stats of Thousand-Faced Maestro: Cameo!'s exclusive Signet Blessing of the Thousand-Faced before enhancement: Ultimate changed to Temp Lead. Temp Lead: Casting it forcibly unleashes the support skill. Bonus Fire DMG dealt increased from 400% to 600% ATK, similar with the stats after enhancement. Other effects remain unchanged.

5. Fixed an issue when Thousand-Faced Maestro: Cameo! is equipped with Signets Blessing of Dream Scales and Blessing of the Thousand-Faced, where the effect of Ultimate dealing bonus Fire DMG due to Blessing of Dream Scales failed to take effect.

6. Fixed an issue in Floor 17 of Deep Sequence, where the type of boss Beast of Sacrifice was inconsistent with the Boss Preview on the prep screen.

7. Fixed an issue in Deep Sequence where the challenge score sometimes glitched and incorrectly displayed "0".



☆☆☆☆☆ Shop ☆☆☆☆☆
◆ Exchange House
Added stigmata Turgenev and Verne.


◆ Elysian Shop
Disciplinary Perdition Rank-Up Stamps will be available, unlocked after clearing Deep Sequence on Inferno and higher with Disciplinary Perdition.



☆☆☆☆☆ Battle Pass ☆☆☆☆☆
1. Added the following purchasable items to BP Works:
[Character Card/Rank-Up Stamp] Dreamweaver Character Card/Rank-Up Stamps, Dreamweaver Rank-Up Stamps (Knight BP or Paladin BP required)
[Weapon] Prophetic Dreams
[Stigmata] As You Wish set: Alexandra

2. Unlock Paladin BP to get Sun-kissed Earth Ribbon.

3. Unlock Knight BP/Paladin BP to get BP Robevyom v8.0. Open it to receive one of the following: Crimson Carol (outfit), Simply Orange (outfit), Everdream (outfit), Indelible Memories (outfit), or 8000 Asterite.

4. BP Arsenal token changed to Honor Chip v8.0 and Provisions Crate changed to Provisions Crate v8.0.



☆☆☆☆☆ System ☆☆☆☆☆
◆ Foundry
You can now craft G4 stigma set Bastet and Prism Stigma set Illuminating the Universe directly.


◆ Bridge Interactions
1. Added interactive animations and voice lines for Reign Solaris.

2. Fixed an issue where the background lighting sometimes glitched on the bridge screen.


◆ Achievements
Added the achievement for obtaining Reign Solaris.


◆ Dorm
Reign Solaris can now move into the Dorm. Her interactions and events are now available.


◆ Returnee and Starter System
Updated the rewards and missions of returnee and starter systems.


◆ Others
1. Fixed an issue where in-game sound effects sometimes glitched and did not play after exiting web events.

2. Fixed an issue on PC where controller functions sometimes glitched when the game was running in the background.

3. Optimized the recommended Graphics Quality setting on some Android devices.

notes.title: Durandal's new S-rank battlesuit Reign Solaris coming soon!
notes.content:
In a world full of possibilities, she embarks on a new journey with the appearance of her childhood self.
—Sincere, charming, dependable, and brave; she remains true to her unchanging self.

Durandal's new S-rank battlesuit Reign Solaris coming soon in v8.0! New Astral Ring Specialization: Law of Ascension will also debut! Read on for more details!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41350040/86772cb6c64afc8bd73c3cc2645e329296202f02.png[/img]

☆☆☆☆☆ Reign Solaris ☆☆☆☆☆
"Gaining strength isn't the end goal, it's the path to protecting others. Is it strange to see me speaking so solemnly in this appearance?"

The wavering world crumbles before Bianka as she shoulders its weight on her shoulders. The path Valkyrie Durandal was on has drastically changed, pushing her to forge her own path.

She has always chosen to walk on valiantly. When Durandal enters the Martian computer as Bianka to face a host of new challenges, she knows that she needs to stay true to herself and take bold steps forward.

—That's how she was, is, and will always be.


◆ How to Get the Battlesuit
After the v8.0 update ~ 12:00, FEB 7, the Battlesuit Supply Solar Radiance will be available. The featured S-rank battlesuit Reign Solaris is guaranteed in 90 drops with 50% off the first 10 drops.


☆☆☆☆☆ New Astral Ring Specialization ☆☆☆☆☆
New S-rank battlesuit Reign Solaris is protected by Astral Ring Specialization: Law of Ascension. After the v8.0 update, Law of Ascension will also grant the Heavenly Shift trait to the Astral Rings of Thousand-Faced Maestro: Cameo!, Lone Planetfarer, and Jovial Deception: Shadowdimmer. These battlesuits will also unlock new Astral Ring skills. Check them out on the battlesuit skill page.

When Law of Ascension is activated, the leader will cause battlesuits with the Heavenly Shift trait to gain enhanced QTE and perform Coordinated ATKs. After activating Astral Ring, battlesuits with the Heavenly Shift trait can enter the field for the first time to cast enhanced QTE and enter Augmented Ascension for some time (regarded as Stellar Outburst). At the same time, the leader's Coordinated ATK is triggered to deal bonus DMG.


☆☆☆☆☆ Skill Showcase ☆☆☆☆☆
Reign Solaris is an IMG-type Physical DMG dealer who fights with a javelin. She is agile as she rides a hoverboard to zip past enemies. Her javelin pierces enemies like a streaking bolt of light as she dominates the battlefield.

◆ Basic ATK + Charged ATK: Rampager form
In the Rampager form, Reign Solaris can perform 3-sequence attacks with the javelin to deal Physical DMG and restore Sunlight KE.

Hold [ATK] to cast up to 3 sequences of Charged ATK and deal Physical DMG while inflicting Stun Trauma on enemies. When Sunlight is maxed out, all Sunlight will be consumed to cast an accelerated Charged ATK.


◆ Basic ATK + Charged ATK: Skyrider form
In Skyrider form, Reign Solaris rides her hoverboard to zip past enemies. She can perform 3-sequence attacks to deal Physical DMG and restore Sunlight KE.

Hold [ATK] to cast up to 3 sequences of Charged ATKs and deal Physical DMG while inflicting Stun Trauma on enemies. When Sunlight is maxed out, tap [ATK] to perform Charged ATK EX. Just like in Rampager form, when Sunlight is maxed out, all Sunlight will be consumed to cast an accelerated Charged ATK.

Casting Charged ATK consumes Skylight Brilliance. Skyrider form ends when Skylight Brilliance is completely depleted.


◆ Weapon Skill: Immortal Glory of Stars
In Rampager form, tap [Weapon] to switch to Skyrider form for battle.

In Skyrider form, tap [Weapon] to cast the skill Take Off. Hold [Weapon] to cast Touch Down and end Skyrider form immediately.


◆ Ultimate: Dauntless Advance
Reign Solaris soars into the clouds on her hoverboard and hurls her weapon down. It pierces the sky and obliterates her enemies with massive Physical DMG.


◆ Astral Ring Skill: Perseverance of the Heart
When Reign Solaris is the leader and in Stellar Outburst, she can cast Stellar Assault and then deploy a battlesuit with the Heavenly Shift trait to cast Stellar Shift. After that, other teammates with the Heavenly Shift trait will also cast Stellar Shift when they next enter the field.

When Reign Solaris is equipped with her recommended weapons, she can cast enhanced QTE Sky-Splitting Flash. Every tap of [ATK] will generate one javelin (up to 4 javelins). Casting the attack hurls all javelins to deal Physical DMG (regarded as Weapon Skill DMG). Reign Solaris also has the Astral Ring trait: Harmonized Shadow Star. She can also join a Shadow Star team.

After casting Stellar Shift, Reign Solaris gains Augmented Ascension. Hold [ATK] to continuously perform Quick Charged ATKs.


☆☆☆☆☆ Key Rank-Up Skills ☆☆☆☆☆
When she reaches S2, a new skill is unlocked.
When Reign Solaris performs Quick Charged ATKs, she deals more Physical DMG.

When she reaches SS, her sub-skill level cap is increased.
When Reign Solaris is the leader, the 3-sequence enhanced Charged ATK and Charged ATK EX after QTE inflicts more IMG-type Elemental Breach.

When she reaches SSS, a new skill is unlocked.
When Reign Solaris performs Ultimate, she deals more Physical DMG.


☆☆☆☆☆ Recommended Equipment ☆☆☆☆☆

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41350040/24e3e5b4636dd040311b05acab5b5ce3f7379bd5.png[/img]

After the v8.0 update ~ 12:00, FEB 7, the recommended equipment for Reign Solaris, Javelin Valorous Effulgence and Illuminating the Universe stigma set will be available in Equipment Supply. A 4★ weapon or stigma is guaranteed in every 10 Equipment Supply drops. You are guaranteed to get 4★ weapon Valorous Effulgence in 60 Equipment Supply drops.

After the v8.0 update ~ 04:00, FEB 20, participate in the login event to get Illuminating the Universe Stigma Option x1. Open it to receive one of Reign Solaris' recommended stigmata. Illuminating the Universe stigma set will also be craftable. Forging a stigma requires Source Prism x2 and Ether Fuel x600.



※ The above info is subject to change in the official release.

notes.title: v7.9 Stars Derailed Update Announcement
notes.content:
Welcome to v7.9 Stars Derailed (NOV 28 ~ JAN 9)! Honkai Impact 3rd x Honkai: Star Rail crossover officially begins!
 
 
Update Content
★ New QUA-type S-rank battlesuit Thousand-Faced Maestro: Cameo!
Thousand-Faced Maestro: Cameo! is a QUA-type Fire DMG dealer protected by World Star. She uses a Drive Core that turns into a revolver in battle, and transforms the battlefield into a stage for her performance. With a variety of props, she puts on a spectacular show as she defeats enemies. She also plays the role of a director as she casts her Ultimate and selects the perfect performer to take the stage.
 
*You can obtain the new battlesuit and her recommended equipment in the following ways:
1. Wonderous Co-Star Battlesuit Supply is available. The featured S-rank battlesuit Thousand-Faced Maestro: Cameo! is guaranteed in 90 drops with 50% off the first 10 drops.
 
2. Equipment Supply is available for a limited time! Recommended for Thousand-Faced Maestro: Cameo!: Drive Core Volatile Sparkler and Inimitable Stage Director stigma set drop rates UP!
 
3. Joyous Comedy login event is available! Log in for 7 days to obtain Inimitable Stage Director Stigma Option x1, 120 Crystals, 2800 Asterite, and AE Imaginon x5. Open Inimitable Stage Director Stigma Option to choose from one of Thousand-Faced Maestro: Cameo!'s recommended stigmata.
 
4. Inimitable Stage Director stigma set is craftable. Forging a stigma requires Source Prism x2 and Ether Fuel x600.
 
 
★ Featured Event: Honkai: A Fool's Hand
Are you curious about what secrets lie under the mask? Well... Let's start with a round of A Fool's Hand!
 
Crossover featured event Honkai: A Fool's Hand begins. Play the event to get Thousand-Faced Maestro: Cameo!'s new outfit Fictitious Game, Best Player Emblem, Crystals, Source Prisms, and more. Claim up to 1000 Crystals through the event!
 
 
★ Part 2 Main Story Chapter VI: Wails Stifled by the Silent Shadow
The pursuit of light is a mistake, and so are those futile thoughts... and persistent wails.
 
New main story Wails Stifled by the Silent Shadow begins. Play the main story and event Excavate? Pursuit? Big Winner! to get Crystals, Source Prisms, Ancient Willpowers, and more.
 
 
★ Bonuses Event: When Petals Flutter
When Petals Flutter begins! During the event, complete 4 of 5 event missions to get Herrscher of Human: Ego Character Card!
 
 
★ Login Event: Surprising Encore
During the event, log in and tap the button at the bottom of the bridge to receive Sparkle's letter and Battlesuit Supply Card x5.
 
 
★ Limited-time Top-up Bonuses: Starry Wishes
During the event, accumulate top-ups to claim Weapon Direct Level-Up Coupon, Herrscher of Finality/Dreamweaver Rank-Up Stamps, Source Prisms, Supply Cards, HOHO Vacation Tickets, and more!
 
 
★ Limited-time Event: Snazzy Cards Club
Play a thrilling round of Snazzy Cards. If you win, the prizes are yours. If you lose... Well, that will never happen!
 
During the Snazzy Cards Club event, play to claim Dazzling Elegance Outfit Option, Snazzy Cards Grandmaster Emblem, Crystals, Source Prisms, and more.
 
*Open Dazzling Elegance Outfit Option to receive one of the following: Before the Dawn (outfit), Freestyle Special (outfit), Rustic Noir (outfit), or 8000 Asterite.
 
 
★ Hyperion Arsenal
New Weapons: Drive Core Volatile Sparkler, PRI-ARM Drive Core Volatile Sparkler: Floral Spectacle
 
New Stigmata: Inimitable Stage Director Stigma Set
 
 
 
Game Adjustments & Optimizations
☆☆☆☆☆ Battlesuits ☆☆☆☆☆

1. Added skill switch button for Weapon Subskill Bygone Shadow.
 
2. Fixed an issue where the lighting of her face sometimes glitched in some stages.
 
3. Fixed an issue in Planet Quaker form where enhanced Basic ATK SEQ 3 sometimes glitched and still dealt DMG and restored Intelligence when interrupted.
 
4. Fixed an issue in Planet Quaker form where enhanced Basic ATK SEQ 3 sometimes glitched and was not cast properly.
 
5. Fixed an issue where the animation for entering Planet Quaker form for the first time sometimes glitched on certain devices.
 
6. Fixed an issue where her model sometimes glitched during Part 2's Open World dialog.
 
7. Fixed an issue where the VFX sometimes glitched when casting Ultimate for the first time.
 
 
◆ Schicksal's Imperative
Fixed an issue where her weapon sometimes glitched in the Open World game mode.
 
 
◆ Jovial Deception: Shadowdimmer
Fixed an issue where the duration of her QTE sometimes glitched after certain characters' Stellar Outburst ends.
 
 
◆ Mad Pleasure: Shadowbringer
Adjusted her hitbox in Part 2's Open World when she is in the Gentle is the Night outfit.
 
 
◆ Fenghuang of Vicissitude
1. Fixed an issue where Feather Burning Mark sometimes glitched and was not triggered after casting her Special ATK.
 
2. Fixed an issue in Superstring Dimension, Inferno: Perilous (main enemy: Herrscher of the Rimestar), where casting Ultimate caused her to glitch and suspend in midair.

notes.title: Sparkle's new S-rank battlesuit Thousand-Faced Maestro: Cameo! debuts!
notes.content:
Sparkle's new S-rank battlesuit Thousand-Faced Maestro: Cameo! debuts. Today, Ai-chan will bring you the new battlesuit info. Read on to learn more!

☆☆☆☆☆ Thousand-Faced Maestro: Cameo! ☆☆☆☆☆
A member of the Masked Fools, a dangerous maestro of theatrics, an eye-catching young lady with twin tails, an inscrutable fish, an unreliable narrator, a director behind the fourth wall...

Forget it, it's impossible to put a definite description to her name since she has always appeared in more than one form.

She is well aware that tricks without victims are pointless and a good show without an audience is a waste of effort. So, she meticulously ensures that everything will be packed with excitement.

This time, she has discovered this place and chosen them...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41350040/767638986b692763b000f00c6d0e127f92edb195.png[/img]


◆ How to Get the Battlesuit
After the v7.9 update ~ 12:00, DEC 27, the Battlesuit Supply Wonderous Co-Star will be available. You are more likely to obtain Thousand-Faced Maestro: Cameo! with 50% off the first 10 drops in this Battlesuit Supply.


☆☆☆☆☆ Skill Showcase ☆☆☆☆☆
Thousand-Faced Maestro: Cameo! is a QUA-type Fire DMG dealer who uses a Drive Core in battle. After casting Ultimate, she can select herself or another teammate to enter the field. If a teammate is selected, the selected character gains Ultimate CD reduction and other buffs.

Sparkle can play many roles. When Astral Ring is not activated, she becomes a splendid Fire DMG support and adds Ignite Trauma to her teammates' ATKs. As the leader of a Resonance team, Dream Fish works as a Domain Resonance mark to deal massive Resonance DMG. As a Resonance team member, she is also a great support for triggering Resonance marks.


◆ Basic ATK: Solo Performance
The power of Sparkle's masks gives her two combat modes. Casting Basic ATK accumulates KE Dramatic Tension needed for Monodrama or Dreamdiver states.

We have never been able to pinpoint her many facades, and this time is no exception.


◆ Combo ATK: Life Is a Gamble
When KE is maxed out, hold [ATK] to cast Combo ATK Artificial Fireworks or Plunge Into Dreams. 1 stack of Deceit will be obtained and she will automatically switch to another Mask form.

When Sparkle enters via QTE, she gains 2 stacks of Deceit. Tap [Weapon] to cast enhanced Combo ATK I Am Elation! If the HP of QUA-type enemies is below a certain percentage in their current phase, it will be instantly depleted.


◆ Ultimate: Thousand-Faced Fool
Cast Ultimate to select Sparkle or another teammate to enter the field.

If Sparkle enters the field, she will inflict Quantum Collapse once and deal massive Fire DMG. Ultimate CD will also be reduced. Well, are you enjoying this display of Elation?

If a teammate enters the field, the character will gain higher Ignore Interrupt and Ultimate CD is reduced. If the character is a Fire DMG dealer, Ultimate consumes less SP. The character's Ultimate also deals bonus Ignite Trauma and inflicts Quantum Collapse once. When Astral Ring is not activated, the character's ATK also deals bonus Ignite Trauma and more Total DMG to enemies of countered types. When the character inflicts Ignite Trauma on enemies, bonus stacks of Ignite are also dealt.


◆ Astral Ring Skill: Mimicking Fireworks
In a Resonance Team, Sparkle can consume Quantum Mech Energy to trigger Resonance marks. When she is the leader and Astral Ring is activated, Dream Fish works as a Domain Resonance Mark to devour the Domain Resonance Marks generated by teammates to trigger Resonance ATKs. When Dream Fish is triggered and deals DMG, the DMG multiplier for this Resonance ATK is increased for subsequent instances.



☆☆☆☆☆ Key Rank-Up Skills ☆☆☆☆☆
When she reaches S1, her sub-skill level cap is increased.
When Sparkle is the leader, Resonance DMG triggered by Dream Fish increases. In Stellar Outburst, she also deals more Total DMG and Fire DMG.

When she reaches S2, a new skill is unlocked and her sub-skill level cap is increased.
When casting Combo ATK Artificial Fireworks or Plunge Into Dreams, global Time Fracture is triggered. When Astral Ring is not activated, the teammate entering the field with her Ultimate will deal more Ignite DMG. The character will also deal more Total DMG to enemies of countered types. After the final blow of Monodrama or Dreamdiver, or when I Am Elation! hits enemies, the character restores more SP.

When she reaches SS, a new skill is unlocked and her sub-skill level cap is increased.
Casting I Am Elation! restores bonus SP. When Sparkle is the leader, bonus DMG from I Am Elation! and Ultimate increases. All enemies take more Total DMG and Fire DMG from Sparkle.

When she reaches SSS, her sub-skill level cap is increased.
In Stellar Outburst, she deals more Total DMG and Fire DMG.



☆☆☆☆☆ Recommended Equipment ☆☆☆☆☆

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41350040/729c12a1bcadf08426c8b70c6c6df5fbbca0ea2a.png[/img]

◆ Volatile Sparkler
Active Skill Wonderous Game: When the wielder has the Domain Resonance tag, it increases Fire DMG dealt. When equipped by Thousand-Faced Maestro: Cameo! and she casts special Combo ATK I Am Elation!, Time-frozen Domain is triggered. Ultimate also inflicts Quantum Collapse an additional time.

Passive Skill Fleeting Night: During Astral Ring Charging, enemies take more Fire DMG from the character. When equipped by Thousand-Faced Maestro: Cameo!, enemies take more Elemental DMG and Physical DMG from the team.

Synergy Skill Magnificent Support: Enemies take more Total DMG from the character on the field and more Fire DMG from the wielder (independent and exclusive).


◆ Inimitable Stage Director Stigma Set
2-pc Bonus: The character deals more Total DMG. When equipped by Thousand-Faced Maestro: Cameo!, enemies take more Total DMG from her. In Stellar Outburst, enemies take more Total DMG from characters with All The World's A Stage.

3-pc Bonus: The character's Combo ATK deals more Fire DMG. When equipped by Thousand-Faced Maestro: Cameo!, enemies take more Fire DMG from her and all team members gain All The World's A Stage. When Astral Ring is not activated: Enemies take more Ignite DMG from team members with Spotlight. Team members with Spotlight also deal more Fire DMG. When World Star is activated: In Stellar Outburst, enemies take more Total DMG from Weapon Skill and more Total DMG. When the character is not the leader, teammates deal more Elemental DMG and Total DMG. Teammates' weapon skills also deal even more Elemental DMG and Total DMG.


◆ How to Get Equipment
After the v7.9 update ~ 12:00, DEC 27, the recommended equipment for Thousand-Faced Maestro: Cameo!, Drive Core Volatile Sparkler and Inimitable Stage Director stigma set, will be available in Equipment Supply. A 4★ weapon or stigma is guaranteed in every 10 Equipment Supply drops. You are guaranteed to get 4★ weapon Volatile Sparkler in 60 Equipment Supply drops.

After the v7.9 update ~ 04:00, JAN 9, log in for 7 days to get Inimitable Stage Director Stigma Option x1. Open it to receive one of Thousand-Faced Maestro: Cameo!'s recommended stigmata. Inimitable Stage Director stigma set will also be craftable. Forging a stigma requires Source Prism x2 and Ether Fuel x600.

※ The above info is subject to change in the official release.
