notes.title: Wilderness Development Logs | Play to obtain Dreamweaver's new outfit!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41350040/cd634992c095818b311f90c397235483980923f9.png[/img]

After landing in an abandoned bubble universe, the struggle to survive in the wilderness begins... Hold on, what are you guys doing here?

Wilderness Development Logs coming soon. Captains will develop a wilderness and help Vita rebuild an abandoned bubble universe. Farming, fishing, and mining aren't the only operational tasks involved. Repairing and upgrading buildings, as well as ensuring technological advancements, are also part of the job. Simulated Beasts will also be around to help out! Play the event to obtain Crystals, Source Prisms, Dreamweaver's new outfit Lulling Waves and more.


Wilderness Development Logs

Time
10:00, OCT 28 ~ 04:00, NOV 28

Required Level
30 or higher

Details
1. This event incorporates a stamina system, with stamina gradually regenerating over time. You can complete daily tasks or increase the Rebuild Level to get Fatigue Reliever Chips, which can be used at Vi Fatigue Reliever to restore stamina.

2. The event features farming, livestock, fishing, and excavation modes in which you need to use various tools. When it comes to farming, you'll have to grab a hoe to till the soil and plant your seeds. Don't forget to water those seeds with a watering can. Lastly, you'll have to be patient and wait for the crops to grow before you can use a scythe to harvest them.

3. This event also features Simulated Beasts modes. You can activate fossils with the Simulated Beasts Manual and obtain Simulated Beasts. After that, Simulated Beasts can be sent to Orange's Farm, Red's Mine, Yellow's Fishery, Purple's Ranch, Simulated Beast Factory, and more to work. In Cyan's Lab, Simulated Beasts can undergo genetic recombination to produce new and unique fossils.

4. The items that you use during the event can be upgraded, offering even more convenience. For instance, when you upgrade an Iron Scythe to a Golden Scythe, you'll be able to harvest ripe crops from three grid spaces in front of you with a charged action. If you further upgrade a Golden Scythe to a Quantum Scythe, you can harvest ripe crops from nine grid spaces in front of you with a charged action.

5. You can follow the instructions in the Guide to Rebuilding to complete missions and get rewards. Increase your Rebuild Level in the Guide to Rebuilding to unlock more modes and event content.

6. Obtain Friendship Calendars by completing daily tasks. After upgrading your Rebuild Level, you can use Friendship Calendars in the Friend Radar page to unlock Friend Radar stories. Play the stories to obtain bonus energy for greater work efficiency and convenience.


Wilderness Supply Depot
The starry sky brightens and dims, the tides ebb and flow. Only the pioneering into this new world will not cease.

Time
10:00, OCT 28 ~ 04:00, DEC 5

Required Level
30 or higher

Details
Obtain Proof of Rejuvenation from Wilderness Development Logs and use them in the event shop Wilderness Supply Depot to exchange for Crystals, Source Prisms, Dreamweaver's new outfit Lulling Waves and more! Play the event to get Ancient Stars Box, Vivid Feathers Box and other rewards too.


*Ai-chan's Reminders:
1. You can obtain enough Proof of Rejuvenation from the event to exchange for all the rewards in Wilderness Supply Depot.

2. From 04:00, NOV 28 ~ 04:00, DEC 5, every 70 Proof of Rejuvenation can be purchased with 50 Crystals in Wilderness Supply Depot. Limited to 30 purchases per Captain.

3. Proof of Rejuvenation will expire at 04:00, DEC 5 and return 500 Coins each.

notes.title: Vita's new S-rank battlesuit Lone Planetfarer coming soon!
notes.content:
New S-rank battlesuit Lone Planetfarer for the elegant, kind, and lovable Vita coming soon! Read on for more details!


☆☆☆☆☆ Lone Planetfarer ☆☆☆☆☆
She's the lone survivor of a planet, wandering the universe in solitude.

She travels through space, roaming freely from planet to planet.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41350040/2e7e63b966b6b0ecfeb36c4e1cf3ec42b96e0042.png[/img]


◆ How to Get the Battlesuit
After the v7.8 update ~ 12:00, NOV 15, the Battlesuit Supply Interstellar Stroll will be available. The featured S-rank battlesuit Lone Planetfarer is guaranteed in 90 drops with the first 10 drops free.


☆☆☆☆☆ Skill Showcase ☆☆☆☆☆
Lone Planetfarer is a MECH-type battlesuit who wields a Drive Core and deals Lightning DMG. After acquiring Sa's authority, Lone Planetfarer ripped open a path to the Sea of Quanta and allowed the Star Traveler to appear. In combat, she leads the Star Traveler to bombard enemies with laser beams and crush them ruthlessly with its fists.

◆ Weapon Skill: Deathly Silence
When Weapon Skill is cast in Lone Traveler form, Lone Planetfarer will generate multiple feathers to attack enemies. After that, Enhanced Basic ATK SEQ 3 and SEQ 4 can be cast with the feathered ring to slash enemies continuously and create a spatial rift. Lightning DMG is dealt while enemies are pulled in. Entering the field with QTE automatically casts Special Weapon Skill.

When equipped with the recommended weapon, Lone Planetfarer's Enhanced Basic ATK SEQ 3 will deal bonus Lightning DMG.

When Weapon Skill is cast in Planet Quaker form, Lone Planetfarer leads the Star Traveler to fire laser beams at enemies. After that, Enhanced Basic ATK SEQ 3 and SEQ 4 can also be cast to make the Star Traveler continue its bombardment of laser beams to deal Lightning DMG and restore Lone Planetfarer's Intelligence.


◆ Combo ATK: Celestial Rupture
When Intelligence is full in Planet Quaker form, hold [ATK] to consume all Intelligence and cast Combo ATK. The Star Traveler will appear in the air and crush enemies with its fists to deal massive Lightning DMG. When the ATK is charging, she gains Iron Body. Hits deal DMG in the form of HP loss.

When equipped with the recommended weapon, Astral Ring Intensity is restored when Lone Planetfarer consumes Stellar Drain for the first time with Combo ATK. The team can unleash the Astral Ring's power more quickly.


◆ Ultimate: Galactic Onslaught
Tap [ULT] in Lone Traveler form to awaken the Star Traveler and enter Planet Quaker form. Her moves will change and she will be granted Invincibility. She will also trigger Time-frozen Domain. After this, repeated animations for her transformations will be simplified.

Tap [ULT] again to cast Ultimate SEQ 2 Nihilation of Planets. The Star Traveler unleashes its full power to deal massive Lightning DMG. She will be granted Invincibility and Time-frozen Domain will be triggered. After Astral Ring is activated and Lone Planetfarer enters Stellar Outburst or casts Ultimate SEQ 2 Nihilation of Planets, all team members gain Omniscient Feathers and deal more Total DMG. All enemies take more Elemental DMG and Physical DMG from characters with Omniscient Feathers.


◆ Astral Ring Skill: Star Voyager
When Lone Planetfarer is the team leader and enters Stellar Outburst, continuously tap [ATK] to make the Star Traveler smash its fists down repeatedly and automatically connect to her Combo ATK.

In a Resonance Team, when Lone Planetfarer enters the field for the first time during Stellar Outburst, the Star Traveler will automatically cast False Abyss to deal Lightning DMG. During this time, repeatedly tap [ATK] to attack and trigger Domain Resonance Marks. Shortly after, Lone Planetfarer will cast Resonance Combo ATK to trigger Domain Resonance Marks again to deal bonus DMG.

In a Shadow Star Team, Lone Planetfarer will transform into a Phantom to join the battle and grant all characters on the field Rondo in the Shadows.

When World Star or Wheel of Destiny is activated, Omniscient Feathers can grant characters with specific traits Elemental Breach or Physical Breach.


☆☆☆☆☆ Key Rank-Up Skills ☆☆☆☆☆
When she reaches S1, her sub-skill level cap is increased.
When World Star or Wheel of Destiny is activated, Lone Planetfarer grants characters with specific traits with a boost of Elemental Breach or Physical Breach.

When she reaches S2, a new skill is unlocked and her sub-skill level cap is increased.
Casting Weapon Skill triggers global Time Fracture. When she is the leader, initial Astral Ring Intensity is increased. She also greatly increases the Elemental DMG and Lightning DMG taken by enemies (independent). If there is at least one team member protected by Rite of Oblivion, Lone Planetfarer deals even more Total DMG and Lightning DMG.

When she reaches SS, her sub-skill level cap is increased.
When enemies are hit by Lone Planetfarer's Enhanced Basic ATK SEQ 4, she gains Abyssal Energy. When she consumes all Stellar Drain to cast Combo ATK, Abyssal Energy is reset and Astral Ring Intensity is restored. When Lone Planetfarer reaches SS, Stellar Drain consumes Abyssal Energy to restore even more Astral Ring Intensity.

When she reaches SSS, a new skill is unlocked.
When Astral Ring is activated and Lone Planetfarer enters the field, all team members deal more DMG and all enemies take more DMG. All team members can still deal considerable DMG even without Lone Planetfarer casting Ultimate SEQ 2 Nihilation of Planets.


☆☆☆☆☆ Recommended Equipment ☆☆☆☆☆

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41350040/b3a1f60ffedf17a4547e865f80b259704fa43b34.png[/img]

◆ Skyveil Feathers
Active Skill Hail of Feathers: The weapon active's CD, max charges, and effects are based on the wielder's type. If there is at least one team member protected by Rite of Oblivion, the wielder's Total DMG increases. When equipped by Lone Planetfarer, Enhanced Basic ATK SEQ 3 in Lone Traveler form and Planet Quaker form deals bonus Lightning DMG. When in combat, consuming Stellar Drain for the first time with Combo ATK restores bonus Astral Ring Intensity. Disabled after triggering Stellar Outburst.

Passive Skill Undulating Sky: Increases the character's Lightning DMG. When equipped by Lone Planetfarer and Astral Ring is activated, enemies take more Total DMG from the character. All team members also deal more Elemental DMG and Physical DMG.

Synergy Skill Swirl of Stars: Enemies take more Total DMG from characters on the field (independent and exclusive). When equipped by Lone Planetfarer, enemies take more Lightning DMG from her (independent).


◆ Across Planets Alone Stigma Set
2-pc Bonus: The character's Basic, Combo, and Charged ATKs deal more Total DMG. When equipped by Lone Planetfarer, enemies take more Lightning DMG from her and characters with I Love Everyone! deal more Total DMG.

3-pc Bonus: The character's Ultimate deals more Lightning DMG. When equipped by Lone Planetfarer: When Astral Ring is activated, all team members gain I Love Everyone!; Lone Planetfarer deals more Lightning DMG; enemies take more Elemental DMG, Physical DMG, and Total DMG from all team members. When World Star is activated, in Astral Ring Charging, Total DMG increases and enemies take more Elemental DMG and Physical DMG. In Stellar Outburst, enemies take more Total DMG from Weapon Skills, more Elemental DMG, and more Physical DMG. When Wheel of Destiny is activated, in Astral Ring Charging, Total DMG increases and enemies take more Elemental DMG and Physical DMG. In Stellar Outburst, enemies take more Elemental DMG.


◆ How to Get Equipment
After the v7.8 update ~ 12:00, NOV 15, the recommended equipment for Lone Planetfarer, Drive Core Skyveil Feathers and Across Planets Alone stigma set will be available in Equipment Supply. A 4★ weapon or stigma is guaranteed in every 10 Equipment Supply drops. You are guaranteed to get 4★ weapon Skyveil Feathers in 60 Equipment Supply drops.

After the v7.8 update ~ 04:00, NOV 28, participate in the login event to get Across Planets Alone Stigma Option x1. Open it to receive one of Lone Planetfarer's recommended stigmata. Across Planets Alone stigma set will also be craftable. Forging a stigma requires Source Prism x2 and Ether Fuel x600.


※ The above info is subject to change in the official release.

notes.title: Planetary Rewind Version Update Announcement
notes.content:
Welcome to v7.8: Planetary Rewind!

Update Content
★ New MECH-type S-rank battlesuit Lone Planetfarer
Lone Planetfarer is a MECH-type Lightning DMG dealer protected by Rite of Oblivion. She uses a Drive Core in battle and crushes enemies with the Star Traveler's bombardment of attacks.

*You can obtain the new battlesuit and her recommended equipment in the following ways:
1. The Battlesuit Supply Interstellar Stroll will be available. The featured S-rank battlesuit Lone Planetfarer is guaranteed in 90 drops with the first 10 drops free.

2. Equipment Supply is available for a limited time! Recommended for Lone Planetfarer: Drive Core Skyveil Feathers and Across Planets Alone stigma set drop rates UP!

3. Participate in the login event to get Across Planets Alone Stigma Option x1. Open it to receive one of Lone Planetfarer's recommended stigmata. 

4. Across Planets Alone stigma set is craftable. Forging a stigma requires Source Prism x2 and Ether Fuel x600.


★ New equipment recommended for Herrscher of Finality: Divine Key Waxing Moon and King of Conquerors stigma set
Divine Keys for Herrscher of Finality: Waxing Moon and PRI-ARM Waxing Moon: Incipience debut! When Herrscher of Finality is equipped with them, activate Astral Ring Specialization: Rite of Oblivion to change her Weapon Skill.

*You can obtain her recommended equipment in the following ways:
1. Equipment Supply available for a limited time! Herrscher of Finality's recommended equipment Divine Key Waxing Moon and King of Conquerors stigma set are available with increased drop rates!

2. Participate in the login event to get King of Conquerors Stigma Option x1. Open it to receive one of Herrscher of Finality's new recommended stigmata. 

3. King of Conquerors stigma set is craftable. Forging a stigma requires Source Prism x2 and Ether Fuel x600.


★ Limited-time Event: Starry Night Gifts! Season of Bonuses
Starry Night Gifts! Season of Bonuses begins! During the event, complete missions on the event page to get shop tokens Wishing Stars, which can be used in event shop Stardust Market to exchange for Red Autumn Foliage Option, a Prism Stigma Direct Level-Up Coupon, Honkai Shards, Einstein's Torus and more!


★ Part 2 Main Story Chapter V: The First and Last War
In the beginning, you were unaware that you were facing the end; in the end, you are fated to return to the beginning.


Play the main story to get Crystals, Source Prisms, and more. During v7.8, complete missions to obtain Perfect Partners Weapon Option and other limited-time rewards.
The event Construction? Imagination? Simulation Battle! will also be released with Part 2 Main Story Chapter V. Play the event to obtain Crystals, Source Prisms, Ancient Willpowers, and more. During v7.8, complete missions to get 4★ stigma Seele: At Leisure (M) and other limited-time rewards!


★ Featured Event: Wilderness Development Logs
After landing in an abandoned bubble universe, the struggle to survive in the wilderness begins... Hold on, what are you guys doing here?
Featured event Wilderness Development Logs begins in v7.8. Play the event to obtain Dreamweaver's new outfit Lulling Waves, Crystals, Source Prisms, and more.


★ Special Event: Carnival Spend Bonuses
Carnival Spend Bonuses available after the v7.8 update ~ 12:00, NOV 15. Spend 30000 Crystals (excluding Returnee Support) to obtain Mad Pleasure: Shadowbringer's new outfit Gentle is the Night! Spend a specific number of Crystals or equal worth of Supply Cards to obtain Carnival Annulons. Use Carnival Annulons to purchase Herrscher of Finality Character Card x1, Herrscher of Finality Rank-Up Stamp x6, Herrscher of Truth Rank-Up Stamp x6, and more at the shop!


★ Login Events: Midnight Hauntings & 10x Carnival Battlesuit Supply Cards & Petrifying Nightmares
After the v7.8 update ~ 04:00, NOV 28, log in for 8 days to claim Across Planets Alone Stigma Option, King of Conquerors Stigma Option, Crystals, and more!

12:00 OCT 19 ~ 12:00, NOV 8, log in to claim 10x Carnival Battlesuit Supply Cards x2 for v7.8's Carnival Battlesuit Supply.

04:00, OCT 22 ~ 04:00, NOV 28, log in for 7 days to claim Miracle Wings Battlesuit Option and Bold Flight Supply Option! Open Miracle Wings Battlesuit Option to receive one of the following: Silverwing: N-EX Character Card x1, Miracle ☆ Magical Girl Character Card x1, Silverwing: N-EX Rank-Up Stamp x5, Miracle ☆ Magical Girl Rank-Up Stamp x5, or Ancient Willpower x600. Open Bold Flight Supply Option to receive one of the following: Battlesuit Supply Card x5, Equipment Supply Card x5, or 1200 Crystals.


★ Featured Event Rerun: TeRiRi's Magical Quest
In pursuit of a lofty and dazzling dream, she secretly made up her mind and embarked on a journey towards miracles. Planning the route, packing her bags, gathering companions... although there were stumbling blocks along the way, she finally made it! However, the big question is whether the end of the journey would live up to her expectations...

Featured event TeRiRi's Magical Quest will be available in v7.8. Play the event to obtain Crystals, Twilight Serenade Outfit Option, Phase Shifters, Honkai Shards, and more!
*Open Twilight Serenade Outfit Option to receive one of the following: outfit Nocturne Ablaze, outfit Magic Girl TeRiRi, outfit Valkyrie Dawn, or 8000 Asterite.


★ Limited-time Event: Starry Night Treasures
10:00, NOV 14 ~ 11:59, NOV 25, complete missions on the Castle Exploration page to obtain Antique Keys and participate in the raffle! Stand a chance to win an iPad Air, AirPods, an Xbox Wireless Controller, and more!


★ Permanent LITE Features
Permanent LITE features added! After the v7.8 update, a Quick LITE feature will be added to Adventure Task, Universal Mirage, Weekly Quiz, Armada Sim Battle, and Material Expedition.

Complete version events and main story missions to obtain HOHO Vacation Tickets which can be used to sweep these game modes for rewards.


★ Hyperion Arsenal
New Weapons: Drive Core Skyveil Feathers, Divine Key Waxing Moon, PRI-ARM Drive Core Skyveil Feathers: Purifying Wish, PRI-ARM Divine Key Waxing Moon: Incipience

New Stigmata: Across Planets Alone stigma set, King of Conquerors stigma set



Game Adjustments & Optimizations
☆☆☆☆☆ Battlesuits ☆☆☆☆☆
The following data are at max skill level:

◆ Schicksal's Imperative
1. Fixed an issue where the casting of her Ultimate Overseer's Right: Leave Approved! when Astral Ring wasn't activated sometimes glitched.

2. Fixed an issue in Stellar Outburst where the animation for consecutive attacks using Quantum Mech Energy sometimes glitched and stopped midway.

3. Fixed an issue where the display of her weapon sometimes glitched.

4. Fixed an issue where the [ULT] button sometimes glitched and disappeared when Wheel of Destiny was activated.

5. Fixed an issue where her puppets sometimes glitched and stayed on the field when Wheel of Destiny was activated and Stellar Outburst had already ended.

6. Fixed an issue during Let Me Leave Work! state, where the skill Message Blocking was sometimes interrupted by Weapon Skill Stress Transfer.

7. Fixed an issue where the reduction of her switch CD sometimes glitched.

8. Fixed an issue in the Elysian Realm battle against Flame-Chaser - Kevin where casting her Ultimate Overseer's Right: Leave Approved! and entering Break Time sometimes did not grant her Invincibility.

9. Edited the skill description for Schicksal's Imperative's Ultimate Overseer's Right: Leave Approved!. This is only a text correction and does not affect the actual skill effects.


◆ Deepspace Anchor: First Light
Fixed an issue in Stellar Outburst where her weapon VFX sometimes glitched.


◆ Herrscher of Finality
Added Evasion sub-skill Leap of Brilliance. Effects: Unlocks the Jump button (tap [Ult] or [Jump] to jump).



☆☆☆☆☆ Equipment ☆☆☆☆☆
◆ Stigmata
Added some effects to 3-pc bonus for In the Name of Finality stigma set: Kiana Kaslana, In the Name of Origin stigma set: Raiden Mei, and In the Name of Truth stigma set: Bronya Zaychik.



☆☆☆☆☆ Gameplay ☆☆☆☆☆
◆ Part 2 Main Story
1. New bridge: Hyperion 11. It can be unlocked after starting Part 2 Main Story Chapter II.

2. New map: Langqiu, 100 Years Ago


◆ Superstring Dimension
1. New stage: Purgatory: Perilous, featuring Sprout of Wishing as the main enemy.

2. New stage: Stellar Crown: Perilous, featuring HOMU Magician as the main enemy.

3. New stage: Sparkle: Perilous, featuring Sahā: Assaka as the main enemy.

4. New stage: Darkness: Perilous, featuring Dominator of Wolves as the main enemy.

5. New stage: Darkness: Perilous, featuring Herrscher of the Rimestar as the main enemy.

6. Fixed an issue in Frosthelm: Perilous (Main enemy: Raven) where the number of Astral Ring Intensity restoration item drops sometimes glitched.

7. Fixed an issue in Quantum: Perilous (Main enemy: Valrahal) where the time taken to restore the QUA shield sometimes glitched in Collapsed state.

8. Fixed an issue in Quantum: Perilous (Main enemy: Valrahal) where the number of Quantum Orbs that appeared sometimes glitched during phase change and after successful evasions of shots.


◆ Memorial Arena
New SSS boss: Sprout of Wishing.


◆ Elysian Realm
1. New playable battlesuit: Lone Planetfarer

2. New support battlesuit: Mad Pleasure: Shadowbringer

3. The replaceable boss for Floor 17 of Deep Sequence is now Dominator of Wolves.

4. Updated the stage effects and buff effects of Deep Sequence.

5. New LITE mode available. After clearing Deep Sequence on a specific difficulty in the previous week, Captains can skip some stages by selecting LITE Combat for that difficulty and lower in the current week.

6. Added special adjustments to Herrscher of Finality when she is equipped with Waxing Moon or Waxing Moon: Incipience.

7. Changed some special effect stats of Schicksal's Imperative: Lightning DMG increased from 40% to 60%.

8. Edited the description of Signet of Bodhi: Motto of Asavakkhaya. This is only a text correction and does not affect the actual Signet effects.



☆☆☆☆☆ Shop ☆☆☆☆☆
◆ Dorm Supply
New S-rank battlesuits available: Herrscher of Flamescion, Miss Pink Elf♪, Infinite Ouroboros, Silverwing: N-EX, Palatinus Equinox, Spina Astera, Disciplinary Perdition


◆ War Treasury
1. Weekly purchase limit of Miracle ☆ Magical Girl Fragments increased from 6 to 8. After the v7.8 update, the purchase limit for Miracle ☆ Magical Girl Fragments will be reset for that week.

2. Adjusted materials required for purchasing Stygian Nymph Character Card, Herrscher of Reason Character Card, Stygian Nymph Fragments, and Herrscher of Reason Fragments from Ancient Legacy to Ancient Willpower.

3. Only Ancient Willpowers are needed to purchase Miss Pink Elf♪ Character Card and Miss Pink Elf♪ Fragments.


◆ Exchange House
Weapon Starlance Prime and stigmata Shakespeare: Adrift added.



☆☆☆☆☆ Battle Pass ☆☆☆☆☆
1. Vanguard BP level rewards no longer offer Spatial Lens. Source Prisms (up to 2) and HOHO Vacation Tickets added.

2. Knight BP level rewards no longer offer Spatial Convectron. Source Prisms (up to 4) added and number of Crystals increased. Purchasing Knight BP immediately grants 600 Crystals. Level up BP to obtain up to 1320 Crystals.

3. Paladin BP level rewards no longer offer Spatial Convectron. Wafer Dataflow, Normal Crystal Core, and Wafer Stabilizer added.

4. Sprout Crystallum will become the new token. You can boost your BP Level and visit the Dorm Shop to obtain Sprout Crystallum.

5. Added the following purchasable items to BP Works:
[Character Card/Rank-Up Stamp] Herrscher of Truth Character Card/Rank-Up Stamp (Knight BP or Paladin BP required)
[ELF] ELF Kiana Kaslana, ELF Project Bunny (Knight BP or Paladin BP required)
[Weapons] Key of Ascension, Seven Thunders of Retribution: Rumble
[Stigmata] In the Name of Truth stigma set: Bronya Zaychik

6. Updated BP rewards for the new season of Knight BP and Paladin BP:
[Fragments] Herrscher of Truth
[Ribbon] Unlock Paladin BP to get Feathers of Celestial Doom Ribbon.
[Outfit] Unlock Knight BP to receive Valkyrie Quicksand's outfit Sandy Coast.

7. BP Works Vintage available:
[Equipment] BP Works Vintage will reopen to sell all weapons and stigma sets that were sold by BP Works in v7.4 to 7.7. These equipment items cost Sakura Crystallum. You can only purchase what you did not buy in v7.4 to 7.7.
[Tokens] You can exchange Sprout Crystallum for 10 Sakura Crystallum at most.

8. Added special effects for unlocking Knight BP and Paladin BP.



☆☆☆☆☆ System ☆☆☆☆☆
◆ Foundry
You can now craft G4 stigma set Bronya: N-EX, Prism Stigma Vita: Lone Planetfarer, and Prism Stigma Iskandar directly.


◆ Story
Story overview added to the skip screen in the main story.

Fixed issues with the main story where the display of text message content sometimes glitched.


◆ Bridge Interactions
Added interactive animations and voice lines for Lone Planetfarer.


◆ Achievements
Added the achievement for obtaining Lone Planetfarer.


◆ Dorm
1. Lone Planetfarer can now move into the Dorm. Her interactions and events are now available.

2. Fixed an issue where Schicksal's Imperative's voice lines sometimes glitched.


◆ Others
1. Reset the rewards for Regular Invitation Event on the Sharing Invitation page.

2. Added 2400-day login reward: Login Emblem.

3. Permanent Quick LITE feature added to Open World Adventure Tasks, Universal Mirage, Weekly Quiz, Armada Sim Battle, and Material Expedition.

4. Added Voyage Log interface. In Voyage Log, tap the button on the top right to enter Chronicles and Voyage Anecdotes modes.

5. Voyage Anecdotes added. From v7.7, some featured events will be permanently available after the respective versions end.

6. Stellar Key slots added to Divine Concierge.

7. Prompts for recommended leaders added to stage prep screen and lineup screen.

8. Adjusted the sorting of characters in the lineup screen. Trial characters will be displayed first.

9. Increased the Stamina storage cap for all levels to 240. Increased the excess Stamina storage cap and expedition Stamina cap.

10. Combined Mei's Lunch and Mei's Dinner in BP missions to Mei's Snacks. Rewards can be redeemed from 04:00 on the current day to 03:59 on the next day.

11. Changed the visuals of some "Share" icons.

notes.title: Born From A Dream
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41350040/8700b8e284a65d909b17edc2fb2ad72f1b68fc5a.png[/img]

As a Fixer, you go about your day resolving problems. But reality starts to crumble when a mysterious person named Vita appears...

New event Schicksal Work Guide coming soon! Enter the "ideal world" of Schicksal Corp to vanquish work monsters, resolve troubling work problems, and rediscover the meaning of work with your companions! Play the event to get Terminal Aide 0017's new outfit Fizzy Ray, I'm Working Emblem, Crystals, Source Prisms and more.


Schicksal Work Guide
Time: 10:00, JUL 29 ~ 04:00, SEP 5

Required Level: 30 or higher

Details
1. In this event, Captains can explore three different maps and complete missions with companions. Maps will be unlocked as the story progresses. Many unexpected work challenges await!

Captains will encounter work monsters while completing work missions. Select suitable employees to form a team of four for battle. Each employee has a different working style and specialty. Team up employees wisely to defeat enemies.

The event will be released over 3 phases. The schedule is as follows:
Far East Branch: 10:00, JUL 29
Anti-Entropy Branch: 10:00, AUG 2
Schicksal HQ: 10:00, AUG 6


2. Complete daily tasks and defeat wandering monsters to gain Work EXP for leveling up the Work Team. After leveling up and completing Workplace Training, employees will gain Core Passive Skills. Captains can also unlock more exploration items. At Level 4 or higher, Auto-combat Doll will be unlocked and auto-combat will be available in most stages.

There is a daily cap to Work EXP gained from defeating wandering monsters.


3. Clear Phase 1's story stages to unlock Overcoming Difficulties stages. In Overcoming Difficulties, Captains must deploy employee teams based on the stage environment and effects. Use the stage environments wisely to clinch victory.

Accumulate 45 Challenge Stars in Overcoming Difficulties to obtain the I'm Working Emblem. This emblem will display the final number of Challenge Stars obtained.


Schicksal Auxiliary Division
Ask not what you can do for Schicksal but what Schicksal can do for you.

Time: 10:00, JUL 29 ~ 04:00, SEP 12

Required Level: 30 or higher

Event Rewards
Play the event to obtain Smile Coins that can be used in Schicksal Auxiliary Division to exchange for Terminal Aide 0017's new outfit Fizzy Ray, Crystals, Source Prisms, Honkai Shards and more!


*Ai-chan's Reminders:
1. You can obtain enough Smile Coins from the event to exchange for all the rewards in event shop.

2. From 04:00, SEP 5 ~ 04:00, SEP 12, every 60 Smile Coins can be purchased with 50 Crystals in Schicksal Auxiliary Division. Limited to 30 purchases per Captain.

3. Smile Coins will expire at 04:00, SEP 12 and return 500 Coins each.

notes.title: Theresa's S-rank battlesuit Schicksal's Imperative debuts!
notes.content:
"If you make me work overtime again, I'll quit!"
"...What? The Overseer can't resign?"

Captains, Theresa's S-rank battlesuit Schicksal's Imperative debuts in v7.7! Today, we'll introduce her and her equipment. Read on to learn more!


☆☆☆☆☆ Schicksal's Imperative ☆☆☆☆☆
After suddenly stepping up as the Overseer, she thinks she is fully prepared for the role. However, the work and responsibilities are more complex than she imagined. It's hard for her to resist the desire to flee.

Yet, she never truly acts on those thoughts. Her complaints have increased, but everyone knows she has never wanted to give up. Clearly, she perseveres due to her sense of responsibility and determination to be as capable as her predecessor.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41350040/e5d9bf0608e3d4765de2ea60e0d592d2a71e85e3.png[/img]


◆ How to Get the Battlesuit
After the v7.7 update ~ 12:00, OCT 4, the Battlesuit Supply Sleepy Wishes will be available. You are more likely to obtain Schicksal's Imperative with 50% off the first 10 drops in this Battlesuit Supply.


☆☆☆☆☆ Skill Showcase ☆☆☆☆☆
Schicksal's Imperative is a QUA-type Lightning DMG dealer who wields chained blades. When she's serious about work, her puppets, Off-Work HOMU and On-Vacay HOMU, will strive hard with her to knock off swiftly. She wears her eye mask and falls asleep when she wants to slack off. As for her unfinished tasks... she'll let her diligent puppets fight on her behalf!

◆ Basic ATK: Solemn Pledge: No AWOL!
In the normal state of Don't Wanna Work!, Schicksal's Imperative can accumulate Stress by performing a triple strike from the ground or swinging the Message-Blocking Swatter in the air to perform a downward smash.

In the enhanced state of Let Me Leave Work!, tap [ATK] in mid-air to perform a 2-sequence combo. During SEQ 2, tap [ATK] to prolong the ATK and release Stress.


◆ Weapon Skill: Celestial Blessings: Slack Enablers!
In the normal state, tap [Weapon] to hurl a Work-Passing Ball at enemies. It grants Stress while dealing DMG.

In the enhanced state, tap [Weapon] to trigger Stress Transfer. She will unleash a flying kick and mark enemies with Substitute Marks. She deals more Total DMG to marked enemies.


◆ Combo ATK: Execution Time: I Hate Overtime!
When her Stress maxes out in the normal state, hold [ATK] to enter the enhanced state Let Me Leave Work!. Hold [ATK] in the enhanced state to consume all Stress and trigger Work Is Over Alarm.

The Work Is Over Alarm Clock will rush at enemies and tell them to start slacking if they're still hard at work.


◆ Ultimate: Overseer's Right: Leave Approved!
After casting Schicksal's Imperative's Ultimate Knock Off Now!, she relaxes on a sofa while her puppets enter the battlefield to attack enemies.

While she is resting, other characters can be switched in. Her puppets will also remain on the battlefield to attack enemies.


If other characters have been switched in, tap Schicksal's Imperative's avatar while she is resting to trigger Work Done in Dreams. She will stretch lazily and return to the battlefield.

Reporting in, the work task is as follows: Deal massive Lightning DMG, inflict Collapse once on enemies, and inflict massive Paralyze Trauma.


◆ Astral Ring Skill: Savior's Legacy: Can't Slack!
When Astral Ring Specialization: World Star is activated, Schicksal's Imperative can consume KE to trigger Resonance Marks and deal DMG through Resonance ATKs. Her Ultimate transforms into a Special Ultimate that deals Lightning DMG and inflicts Collapse on surrounding enemies once.

When Schicksal's Imperative is the leader, enter the enhanced state by activating her Astral Ring. Her two puppets will serve as Domain Resonance Marks. Each time a Resonance Mark is triggered, the ATK Multiplier increases. The puppets can also devour the Domain Resonance Marks generated by teammates to trigger Resonance ATKs automatically for bonus DMG.

When Astral Ring Specialization: Wheel of Destiny is activated, Schicksal's Imperative becomes a Phantom to cast Shadow Star Attacks.



☆☆☆☆☆ Recommended Equipment ☆☆☆☆☆

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41350040/2947c943ca2619865cae49a6eb33476d89a56dfd.png[/img]

◆ Vacation Notice
Active Skill: Vacay for Everyone!: In Stellar Outburst, enemies take more Elemental DMG. When equipped by Schicksal's Imperative, SEQ 2 of QTE ATKs and Ultimates will grant Stress. Enemies take more Total DMG from Resonance and Shadow Star Attacks.

Passive Skill: Work Ban: The team deals more Elemental DMG and Physical DMG. When equipped by Schicksal's Imperative, enemies on the field take more Total DMG. The team receives a shield that can negate QUA-type ATKs once. When the shield is attacked, enemies will enter a weakened state. Negating or evading a QUA-type ATK will inflict Collapse once. When SEQ 2 of QTE ATKs or Ultimates hit enemies, they will be inflicted with Paralyze Trauma.


Synergy Skill: Do Not Disturb: Enemies take more Total DMG from characters on the field and more Lightning DMG from the wielder. When the QUA shield explodes, the AoE of Collapse increases.


◆ Day After Day Stigma Set
2-pc Bonus: Total DMG of Ultimate and burst mode attacks increases. When equipped by Schicksal's Imperative, during Stellar Outburst when World Star is activated, enemies take more Total DMG from her teammates and her teammates deal more Lightning DMG. During Astral Ring Charging, the character's Lightning DMG increases. During Stellar Outburst when Wheel of Destiny is activated, enemies take more Physical DMG from teammates.

3-pc Bonus: Lightning DMG increases. When equipped by Schicksal's Imperative, entering Stellar Outburst or casting Ultimate increases Total DMG dealt for a specific duration. When Astral Ring is not activated, a downward smash increases her teammates' Total DMG. When Wheel of Destiny is activated, enemies take more Total DMG from some teammates, and these teammates have increased Crit Rate. When World Star is activated, Resonance ATKs deal more Total DMG. Enemies take more Elemental DMG from characters protected by World Star. Some teammates also deal increased Total DMG. During Stellar Outburst when World Star or Wheel of Destiny is activated, teammates deal more Elemental DMG and Physical DMG. The entire team deals more Total DMG.


◆ How to Get Equipment
After the v7.7 update, Schicksal's Imperative's recommended equipment items are likely to drop in Equipment Supply. Chained Blades Vacation Notice or one of the three stigmata from the Day After Day stigma set is guaranteed in every 10 drops. Vacation Notice is guaranteed in 60 drops.

After the v7.7 update ~ 04:00, OCT 17, play the login event Vacation Signal to obtain Day After Day Stigma Option x1. Open it to receive one of Schicksal's Imperative's recommended stigmata. Day After Day stigma set will also be craftable. Forging a stigma requires Source Prism x2 and Ether Fuel x600.


※ The above info is subject to change in the official release.

Schicksal's Imperative is a QUA-type Lightning DMG dealer who wields chained blades. When she's serious about work, her puppets, Off-Work HOMU and On-Vacay HOMU, will strive hard with her to knock off swiftly. She wears her eye mask and falls asleep when she wants to slack off. As for her unfinished tasks... she'll let her diligent puppets fight on her behalf!

*You can obtain the new battlesuit and her recommended equipment in the following ways:
1. Sleepy Wishes Battlesuit Supply is available. The featured S-rank battlesuit Schicksal's Imperative is guaranteed in 90 drops with 50% off the first 10 drops.

2. Equipment Supply is available for a limited time. Recommended for Schicksal's Imperative: Chained Blades Vacation Notice and Day After Day stigma set drop rates UP!

3. Vacation Signal event is available! Log in for 7 days to obtain Day After Day Stigma Option x1, 120 Crystals, 2800 Asterite, and AE Imaginon x5. Open Day After Day Stigma Option to choose from one of Schicksal's Imperative's recommended stigmata.

4. Day After Day stigma set is craftable. Forging a stigma requires Source Prism x2 and Ether Fuel x600.


★ Featured Event Born From A Dream
As a Fixer, you go about your day resolving problems. But reality starts to crumble when a mysterious person named Vita appears...

Defend your mind from nightmares with Vita's help! Event rewards Chrono Navi's new outfit Guiding Star, Feathery Dreams Emblem, Crystals, Source Prisms, and more.


★ Part 2 Main Story Chapter IV: A Shore Under Watch
Who is the ocean, and who am I?
I shall find the answer after the world ends.

In v7.7, new story chapter A Shore Under Watch will be available. Play the main story and the event Investigation? Theresa's Great Adventure to claim Dreamseeker Chips to upgrade Dreamseeker, Crystals, Source Prisms, Ancient Willpowers, and more.


★ Limited-time Top-up Bonuses: Starry Wishes
During the event, accumulate top-ups to claim Weapon Direct Level-Up Coupons, Herrscher of Truth/Herrscher of Human: Ego Rank-Up Stamps, Source Prisms, Supply Cards, Boosters, and more bonuses!


★ Limited-Time Event Schicksal's Vacation
During the event, play login events, the main story, featured events, and more to obtain Vacation Tickets. On the event page, use Vacation Tickets to sweep Adventure Tasks, Universal Mirage, and Weekly Quiz for immediate event rewards.


★ Hyperion Arsenal
New Weapons: Chained Blades Vacation Notice; PRI Chained Blades Vacation Notice: Emergency Overtime

New Stigmata: Day After Day Stigma Set



☆☆☆☆☆ Battlesuits ☆☆☆☆☆
The following data are at max skill level:

◆ Jovial Deception: Shadowdimmer
1. Fixed an issue where she exits Stellar Outburst and Combo ATK was sometimes wrongly cast when Combo KE was not fully charged.

2. Fixed an issue during Stellar Outburst where the wrong number of Odd Thoughts were sometimes gained when Basic ATKs hit enemies.

3. Fixed an issue where Spiritual Verdure's weapon skill sometimes glitched.

4. Fixed an issue where she sometimes froze after entering via QTE.

5. Fixed an issue where her evasion movement sometimes glitched.

notes.title: Schicksal Work Guide | Play to obtain a new outfit, Crystals and more!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41350040/0e71d618b689cf626a2c7762de3510670d85ba57.png[/img]


New event Schicksal Work Guide coming soon! Enter the "ideal world" of Schicksal Corp to vanquish work monsters, resolve troubling work problems, and rediscover the meaning of work with your companions! Play the event to get Terminal Aide 0017's new outfit Fizzy Ray, I'm Working Emblem, Crystals, Source Prisms and more.


Schicksal Work Guide
Time: 10:00, JUL 29 ~ 04:00, SEP 5

Required Level: 30 or higher

Details
1. In this event, Captains can explore three different maps and complete missions with companions. Maps will be unlocked as the story progresses. Many unexpected work challenges await!

Captains will encounter work monsters while completing work missions. Select suitable employees to form a team of four for battle. Each employee has a different working style and specialty. Team up employees wisely to defeat enemies.

The event will be released over 3 phases. The schedule is as follows:
Far East Branch: 10:00, JUL 29
Anti-Entropy Branch: 10:00, AUG 2
Schicksal HQ: 10:00, AUG 6


2. Complete daily tasks and defeat wandering monsters to gain Work EXP for leveling up the Work Team. After leveling up and completing Workplace Training, employees will gain Core Passive Skills. Captains can also unlock more exploration items. At Level 4 or higher, Auto-combat Doll will be unlocked and auto-combat will be available in most stages.

There is a daily cap to Work EXP gained from defeating wandering monsters.


3. Clear Phase 1's story stages to unlock Overcoming Difficulties stages. In Overcoming Difficulties, Captains must deploy employee teams based on the stage environment and effects. Use the stage environments wisely to clinch victory.

Accumulate 45 Challenge Stars in Overcoming Difficulties to obtain the I'm Working Emblem. This emblem will display the final number of Challenge Stars obtained.


Schicksal Auxiliary Division
Ask not what you can do for Schicksal but what Schicksal can do for you.

Time: 10:00, JUL 29 ~ 04:00, SEP 12

Required Level: 30 or higher

Event Rewards
Play the event to obtain Smile Coins that can be used in Schicksal Auxiliary Division to exchange for Terminal Aide 0017's new outfit Fizzy Ray, Crystals, Source Prisms, Honkai Shards and more!


*Ai-chan's Reminders:
1. You can obtain enough Smile Coins from the event to exchange for all the rewards in event shop.

2. From 04:00, SEP 5 ~ 04:00, SEP 12, every 60 Smile Coins can be purchased with 50 Crystals in Schicksal Auxiliary Division. Limited to 30 purchases per Captain.

3. Smile Coins will expire at 04:00, SEP 12 and return 500 Coins each.

notes.title: New S-rank Battlesuit Jovial Deception: Shadowdimmer debuts!
notes.content:
v7.6 coming soon! Songque's S-rank battlesuit Jovial Deception: Shadowdimmer debuts! Today, we'll introduce her and her equipment. Read on to learn more!

☆☆☆☆☆ Jovial Deception: Shadowdimmer ☆☆☆☆☆
With a smile, she weaves lies with honeyed words to conceal the light of a star and spark hope in a land plagued by calamity.
These seeds of hope will sprout to bring new life.

"Fate is forged by our hands and our appearance reflects our hearts. I will be worthy of this outfit and live up to the expectations of everyone in Langqiu."
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41350040/076b27dc355afa6c9d183ed20865214918c2c322.png[/img]


◆ How to Get the Battlesuit
After the v7.6 update ~ 12:00, AUG 23, the Battlesuit Supply Leaf of Gold will be available. You are more likely to obtain Jovial Deception: Shadowdimmer with 50% off the first 10 drops in this Battlesuit Supply.

From 10:00, JUL 27 ~ 04:00, SEP 5, Gifts of Gratitude will be available. Tap the button at the bottom of the bridge to receive Songque's letter of blessing. Open the mail to claim Battlesuit Supply Card x5.


☆☆☆☆☆ Skill Showcase ☆☆☆☆☆
New S-rank battlesuit Jovial Deception: Shadowdimmer has two forms. She first appears as Spiritual Verdure and transforms into Divine Gold behind screens in Stellar Outburst.

◆ Basic ATK: Zhen: Mastery of Weapons and Fear
Jovial Deception: Shadowdimmer deals Physical DMG with a 3-sequence attack. Hitting enemies will conjure Shadow Frames that look like screens on the field to attack enemies.

After obtaining Jovial Deception: Shadowdimmer's recommended weapon Purge of Ten Faces and PRI-ARM weapon Purge of Ten Faces: Axial Shift, the total number of Shadow Frames that can be conjured increases from 3 to 6.


◆ Weapon Skill: Li: Fearless New Paths of Light
When Jovial Deception: Shadowdimmer has cast Basic ATKs to conjure 3 Shadow Frames, tap [Weapon] to recall all Shadow Frames. Jovial Deception: Shadowdimmer will cast Spiritual: Shower of Stars. Meteorites fall and deal Physical DMG to enemies.


◆ Combo ATK: Dui: Gratifying Union of Hearts
When Jovial Deception: Shadowdimmer consumes Shadow Frames, Combo KE will be restored. When Combo KE is fully restored, hold [ATK] to cast Spiritual: Swim of Dragon. Gushing currents of a river surge forth with a huge Shadow Fish to deal Physical DMG to enemies.


◆ Ultimate: Qian: Deception in Shadows for Auspice
After casting Ultimate, countless Shadow Fish swirl at the wave of her staff and turn into talismans to envelop enemies. She smiles as her enemies are defeated under dazzling fireworks.

Jovial Deception: Shadowdimmer's Ultimate can be cast with any SP, but will consume all SP once cast. When a certain amount of SP is consumed, Ultimate will deal bonus Physical DMG to enemies.


◆ Astral Ring Skill: Kun: Heavenly Calling for Shu's Law
In Stellar Outburst, Jovial Deception: Shadowdimmer will transform behind screens and reappear in the new form of Divine Gold.

Subskill Zealous Morning can be toggled to reduce the frequency of the transformation animation playing in battle. When this skill is activated, Jovial Deception: Shadowdimmer's transformation animation will only be shown when she enters Stellar Outburst for the first time.

Astral Ring Basic ATK: In Stellar Outburst, Jovial Deception: Shadowdimmer's Basic ATK becomes Divine: Banishing Ten Miseries. She executes a 3-sequence jump attack and gains an Odd Thought with each hit.

Astral Ring Weapon Skill: In Stellar Outburst, Jovial Deception: Shadowdimmer consumes Odd Thoughts to cast Weapon Skill Divine: Dispelling Misfortunes. She deals Physical DMG and gains Combo KE. If she is equipped with her recommended weapon, she can consume all Odd Thoughts to cast an enhanced Weapon Skill Divine: Eminence of Dawn and deal increased DMG.

Astral Ring Combo ATK: In Stellar Outburst, Jovial Deception: Shadowdimmer consumes Combo KE to cast Divine: Spectacle of Light. Countless light rays will slice enemies like blades and deal Physical DMG.

Astral Ring Ultimate: When Wheel of Destiny is activated and Ultimate is cast in Stellar Outburst, Jovial Deception: Shadowdimmer will exit Stellar Outburst and gain Astral Ring Intensity based on the remaining Astral Ring duration.


☆☆☆☆☆ Recommended Equipment ☆☆☆☆☆
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41350040/f8e8874d06b3f51aa39922b3c976086bf091d6b6.png[/img]

◆ Purge of Ten Faces
Active Skill: The weapon active's CD, max charges, and effects are based on wielder's type. When the character has the Harmonized Shadow Star tag, she deals more Physical DMG. When equipped by Jovial Deception: Shadowdimmer, the team's Total DMG is increased. She can conjure up to 6 Shadow Frames and accumulate up to 6 Odd Thoughts. Casting a weapon skill in Spiritual Verdure form and conjuring 6 Shadow Frames at once will deal additional Physical DMG. When Wheel of Destiny is activated and Phantoms attack, Odd Thoughts can be consumed to cast a special weapon skill to deal DMG and restore KE. Phantoms conjured from jump attacks during Rondo in the Shadows can restore Odd Thoughts.

Passive Skill: Increases Total DMG. When equipped by Jovial Deception: Shadowdimmer, the team's QTEs deal more Total DMG and Physical DMG, and Crit DMG from weapon skills and Combo ATKs is increased.

Synergy Skill: Enemies take more Total DMG from the character on the field (independent). When there is only 1 enemy on the field, the character on the field deals more Physical DMG (independent).


◆ Leaf's Visions Stigma Set
2-pc Bonus: Reduces the Total DMG taken by the character, and increases the team's Crit DMG and Elemental DMG. When equipped by Jovial Deception: Shadowdimmer, enemies on the field take more Physical DMG from her. Another Possibility increases Crit DMG and Elemental DMG when Wheel of Destiny is activated.

3-pc Bonus: Increases Crit Rate and Crit DMG. When equipped by Jovial Deception: Shadowdimmer, it increases Crit DMG. When Combo ATK or QTE hit or when entering Stellar Outburst, all teammates gain the Another Possibility buff, which increases Total DMG. Retriggering refreshes the duration. When Wheel of Destiny is activated, Another Possibility increases Elemental DMG, Physical DMG, and Ranged ATKs' Total DMG. When Wheel of Destiny is activated and Jovial Deception: Shadowdimmer has gained Another Possibility, enemies take more Total DMG (exclusive). When Jovial Deception: Shadowdimmer is on the field, all enemies are impaired, which reduces their DEF. When Wheel of Destiny is activated, all other characters on the team deal more Total DMG for each character on the team protected by Wheel of Destiny. When Astral Ring is not activated, Crit DMG, Physical DMG, and Total DMG increase.


◆ How to Get Equipment
After the v7.6 update, Jovial Deception: Shadowdimmer's recommended equipment items are likely to drop in Equipment Supply. Trick Staff Purge of Ten Faces or one of the three stigmata from the Leaf's Visions set is guaranteed in 10 drops. Purge of Ten Faces is guaranteed in 60 drops.

After the v7.6 update ~ 04:00, SEP 5, play the login event Carefree Wanders to obtain Leaf's Visions Stigma Option x1. Open it to receive one of Jovial Deception: Shadowdimmer's recommended stigmata. Leaf's Visions stigma set will also be craftable. Forging a stigma requires Source Prism x2 and Ether Fuel x600.


※ The above info is subject to change in the official release.

notes.title: Event Lantern Against Shadows begins!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41350040/d1a0e95229adfa92f7a7fd8e79b7a94c6f82bd5a.png[/img]

In the distant past, people would always light up lanterns to drive away the fear in the shadows.

Featured event Lantern Against Shadows coming soon! Journey 100 years back into Langqiu's past with Helia and Coralie. Turn into chess pieces and clinch a glorious victory on the chessboard! Play the event to get Miracle ☆ Magical Girl's new outfit Magic Academy Uniform, Deceptive Chess Emblem, Crystals, Source Prisms and more.

Time: After the v7.5 update ~ 04:00, JUL 25

Required Level: 30 or higher

Details
1. In this event, Captains will select characters to be Commanders on the chessboard and battle enemies.

During a battle, chess pieces will be randomly deployed on the board and fight automatically. Commanders can fuse, withdraw, or refresh chess pieces to their advantage. Bond can be activated using chess pieces for buffs. Clear all waves of enemies to win.

The event will be released over 3 phases. The schedule is as follows:
Beyond the Twilight: After the v7.5 update
Step Into the Long Night: 10:00, JUN 10
To Reach Daybreak Someday: 10:00, JUN 14

2. Clear Edge of Shadow Calamity 1-4 to unlock Abyss Drenched in Shadow. After clearing a stage, spend Purge Coupons to instantly obtain that stage's sweep rewards. During the event, 2 Purge Coupons are issued daily. Take part in Abyss Drenched in Shadow to get Chess Chips for leveling up Commanders, enhancing Active Skills, and unlocking Passive Skills.

3. Clear Abyss Drenched in Shadow 5 to unlock Endless Night and face more challenging battles in this mode. Clearing each wave of enemies will trigger changes to the stage environment. Commanders or enemies may gain buffs or suffer debuffs. Strategically manipulate chess pieces to adapt to the new environment.
Unlock the Deceptive Chess Emblem after clearing Abyss Drenched in Shadow F10. The emblem will record the highest challenge record of Endless Night.

4. Commander stats will be automatically recorded at specific milestones during the battle. If you withdraw from a battle or suffer a defeat, you can swiftly rejoin the battle from any recorded milestone.


"Lantern's" Arsenal
Get ready. We're heading out soon.

Time: After the v7.5 update ~ 04:00, AUG 1

Required Level: 30 or higher

Event Rewards
Organization Tokens obtained from the event can be traded for Miracle ☆ Magical Girl's new outfit Magic Academy Uniform, Crystals, Source Prisms, Honkai Shards, and more in the event shop "Lantern's" Arsenal~


*Ai-chan's Reminders:
1. You can obtain enough Organization Tokens from the event to exchange for all the rewards in the event shop.

2. From 04:00, JUL 25 to 04:00, AUG 1, every 18 Organization Tokens can be purchased with 20 Crystals in "Lantern's" Arsenal. Limited to 99 purchases per Captain.

3. Organization Tokens will expire at 04:00, AUG 1 and return 2500 Coins each.

Today's landscape feels like a repeat of yesterday's. They can't alter their destiny any more than they can change who they are.

During v7.5, explore the main story and complete specific missions to get Crystals, Source Prisms, Ancient Willpowers and more.

In the distant past, people would always light up lanterns to drive away the fear in the shadows.

notes.title: New S-rank Battlesuit Lone Destruction: Shadowchaser Debuts
notes.content:
New S-rank battlesuit Lone Destruction: Shadowchaser joins the fight in v7.5! Today, Ai-chan will bring you the latest battlesuit info. Read on to learn more!

☆☆☆☆☆ Lone Destruction: Shadowchaser ☆☆☆☆☆
She arrives with a chant, dispelling calamities in her wake.
She's a finely honed blade, a flame that never fades.
"As long as darkness persists, this light will endure."

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41350040/fa711debbedb130a7ebfc2f3183ad5f7c92d7500.png[/img]

◆ How to Get the Battlesuit
After the v7.5 update and until 12:00, JUL 5, the Battlesuit Supply Iridescent Glow will be available. You are more likely to obtain Lone Destruction: Shadowchaser with 50% off the first 10x drops in this Battlesuit Supply.


☆☆☆☆☆ Skill Showcase ☆☆☆☆☆
Lone Destruction: Shadowchaser is a PSY-type battlesuit dealing Fire DMG with a Rapid-Shot Crossbow. She switches between three different weapons quickly and bombards enemies with attacks using vestiges. No enemy will survive the Lone Destruction: Shadowchaser's rapid attacks.

◆ Basic ATK: Remarkable Luminescence
Lone Destruction: Shadowchaser has three firearms: Rapid-Shot Crossbow, Shotgun, and Submachine Gun. Each firearm comes with its own unique Basic ATK. Hits restore her Blast Energy.


◆ Weapon Skill: Brilliant Glory
Tap [Weapon] to switch between three types of firearms. Tap [Weapon] while attacking to cast Firepower Rotation and switch firearms. Casting Firepower Rotation generates a vestige to use the next sequence of the last firearm's Basic ATK in her place.


◆ Combo ATK: Unmatched Glow
When Blast Energy is full, hold [ATK] to consume Blast Energy and cause Lone Destruction: Shadowchaser to leap into the air to launch a HE Round with a rocket launcher. She will generate a black hole to pull enemies in and deal Fire DMG to enemies in a large area.


◆ Ultimate: Nocturnal Blaze
After casting Ultimate, vestiges with each firearm will join Lone Destruction: Shadowchaser in the fight and deal massive Fire DMG to incinerate enemies. During Ultimate, Time-frozen Domain is triggered.


◆ Astral Ring Skill: Dazzling Brilliance
During Stellar Outburst, Lone Destruction: Shadowchaser will gain Concentrated Blast Energy. Combo ATKs will consume all Concentrated Blast Energy to generate vestiges for the fight.

When Astral Ring Specialization: Wheel of Destiny is activated and during Stellar Outburst, tap [ATK] for Lone Destruction: Shadowchaser to automatically cast Firepower Rotation. Those on standby will morph into Phantoms to provide support in battle. Hits by Phantoms will restore Concentrated Blast Energy and enhance Firepower Rotation. Casting Firepower Rotation again will generate another Phantom to deal additional DMG.


☆☆☆☆☆ Recommended Equipment ☆☆☆☆☆

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41350040/6634cd2f3c275720810a8840f33b19bc1399a6dc.png[/img]

◆ Burn the Long Night
Active Skill Vanquishment by Fire: When equipped by Lone Destruction: Shadowchaser, she starts with full Blast Energy. Switching firearms will make her throw out an additional Piercing Blade as a Weapon Skill. The Piercing Blade explodes on hit, dealing Fire DMG. Enemies hit by Weapon Skills and Combo ATKs will suffer more Fire DMG and reduced Move Speed.

Passive Skill Blazing Menace: When equipped by Lone Destruction: Shadowchaser, she starts with 3 stacks of Supreme Incarnation. If she is hit when granted with Battle Instinct, 1 stack of Supreme Incarnation will be consumed to automatically perform Ultimate Evasion once. When Astral Ring is activated, characters with Astral Ring will deal more Elemental DMG and Physical DMG.

Synergy Skill Firearms Extraordinaire: Enemies take more Total DMG from the character on the field. When equipped by Lone Destruction: Shadowchaser, her initial SP is increased.


◆ A Forged Light Stigma Set
2-pc Bonus Guardian's Weapons: The character's Ultimate deals more Total DMG. When equipped by Lone Destruction: Shadowchaser with Hanging Flame and when Astral Ring Specialization: Wheel of Destiny is activated, she deals more Fire DMG during Stellar Outburst, all enemies on the field take more Total DMG, and all characters on the team deal more Physical DMG and Crit DMG.

3-pc Bonus Fluorescent Night: The character deals more Fire DMG. When equipped by Lone Destruction: Shadowchaser, she deals more Fire DMG under specific circumstances. When Astral Ring Specialization: Wheel of Destiny is activated, enemies take more DMG from some characters, and some characters on the team will deal more Crit DMG. When Astral Ring Specialization: World Star is activated, the character deals more Total DMG through Resonance. When Astral Ring Specialization: World Star or Astral Ring Specialization: Wheel of Destiny is activated, all characters deal more Elemental DMG and gain a higher Crit Rate.


◆ How to Get Equipment
After the v7.5 update and until 04:00, JUL 25, play the login event Fragments of Solitary Light to get A Forged Light Stigma Option x1, which grants one of Lone Destruction: Shadowchaser's recommended stigmata.

After the v7.5 update and until 04:00, JUL 5, Lone Destruction: Shadowchaser's recommended Rapid-Shot Crossbow Burn the Long Night and recommended stigma set A Forged Light are more likely to drop in Equipment Supply. Weapon Burn the Long Night or a piece of A Forged Light stigma set is guaranteed in 10 drops. Weapon Burn the Long Night is guaranteed in 60 drops.

A Forged Light stigma set is now craftable. Forging a stigma requires Source Prism x2 and Ether Fuel x600.


※ The above info is subject to change in the official release.

notes.title: Event Flying to Oxia begins!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41350040/738077092306e452145c7827a42c3f863daa547b.png[/img]

Flying to Oxia Invitation Contest
Become the star of the game and the center of attention!

Time: 10:00, MAY 9 ~ 04:00, JUN 6

Required Level: 30 or higher

Details

1. In this event, each enemy has its own position and size, and you need to remove the pieces they occupy to deal damage. Game pieces come in five types: exclusive, melee, support, projectile, and shooting, each with its own unique attack effects. Selecting the right characters for combat and strategically arranging these pieces can maximize their effectiveness in battle.

The event features three areas that will be released over phases. The schedule is as follows:

Antares Town: 10:00, MAY 9

Blade Cove: 10:00, MAY 13

Chaotic Starry Sky: 10:00, MAY 17

2. Clear Antares Town 4 to unlock Daily Challenge stages, which are the main source of obtaining Invitation Contest Entry Tickets. You can use Invitation Contest Entry Tickets on the Character Growth Screen to level up characters for unlocking more skills. There is a daily cap to the Invitation Contest Entry Tickets you can obtain from Daily Challenge stages.

3. Clear Antares Town 9 to unlock The Top of Oxia stage. You need to explore further in the stage to defeat stronger and stronger enemies. Clear F25 of The Top of Oxia to unlock the emblem The Top of Oxia Trophy, which will display the highest floor you've cleared.

4. You can clear EX stages and The Top of Oxia stages to get Mystery Gachapons, which can be used on the Oxia Treasure screen to draw more game pieces. You can star up duplicate game pieces to strengthen them. Oxia Treasure unlocks once you clear Antares Town 3.

Event Shop Competition Backups

Dear player, welcome to the points exchange stop! Please claim the resources you need!

Time: 10:00, MAY 9 ~ 04:00, JUN 13

Required Level: 30 or higher

Event Rewards

Play the event to get Wireless Treasures, which can be used in event shop Competition Backups to exchange for Sugary Starburst's new outfit Fuzzy Pink Love, Crystals, Source Prisms, Honkai Shards and more!

*Ai-chan's Reminders:

1. You can obtain enough Wireless Treasures from the event to exchange for all the rewards in event shop.

2. From 04:00, JUN 6 to 04:00, JUN 13, every 18 Wireless Treasures can be purchased with 15 Crystals in Competition Backups. Limited to 99 purchases per Captain.

3. Wireless Treasures will expire at 04:00, JUN 13 and return 625 Coins each.

notes.title: New S-rank Battlesuit Mad Pleasure: Shadowbringer Debuts
notes.content:
Thelema's S-rank battlesuit Mad Pleasure: Shadowbringer debuts! Today we'll introduce her and her equipment. Read on to learn more!

☆☆☆☆☆ Mad Pleasure: Shadowbringer ☆☆☆☆☆
Servants, foes, and even fear itself.

The girl will conquer all she sees, and then, enlighten the world about the true essence of pleasure.

"The banquet is upon us. Now, raise your cups — and acclaim my name!"

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41350040/67a8f72380939a30a459d28e9388f85dcc8a4548.png[/img]

Character Type: MECH
Weapon: Chained Blades
DMG Type: Ice
Astral Ring Specialization: Wheel of Destiny

◆ How to Get the Battlesuit
After the v7.4 update and until 12:00, MAY 24, the Battlesuit Supply Dancing With Shadows will be available. You are more likely to obtain Mad Pleasure: Shadowbringer with 50% off the first 10x drops in this Battlesuit Supply.


☆☆☆☆☆ Skill Showcase ☆☆☆☆☆
Mad Pleasure: Shadowbringer is agile and swift, and she employs a diverse range of techniques with her chained blades in combat to frequently overpower enemies. Whether battling on the ground or engaging enemies in aerial combat, she showcases formidable strength capable of instilling fear in the most courageous adversaries.

◆ Basic ATK - Banquet Invite: Be Seated
Tap [ATK] on the ground or in the air to let Mad Pleasure: Shadowbringer perform a triple strike, dealing Ice DMG. The third attack restores Banquet Enjoyments on hit, and improves her Ignore Interrupt.

◆ Weapon Skill - Liquor: A Toast to Everyone
While battling on the ground or in the air, Mad Pleasure: Shadowbringer can use different weapon skills. Tap [Weapon] to cast weapon skill for pulling in enemies. Hold [Weapon] to cast weapon skill for inflicting Rime Trauma on enemies. She will recover Banquet Enjoyment when hitting enemies with weapon skill.

◆ Combo ATK - Stay Seated: As the Host Commands
While on the ground, hold [ATK] to let Mad Pleasure: Shadowbringer perform an upward thrust. While in the air, hold [ATK] to let Mad Pleasure: Shadowbringer perform a downward cleave. She will recover Banquet Enjoyment when hitting enemies with Combo ATK.

◆ Special Combo - Orchestra: Endless Banquet Dance
Mad Pleasure: Shadowbringer can have up to 6 points of Banquet Enjoyments. With full Banquet Enjoyments, tap [ATK] after evasion or jump to consume all Banquet Enjoyments and let Mad Pleasure: Shadowbringer trigger Moment of Indulgence, which pulls in enemies and deals Ice DMG to them.


◆ Ultimate - Banquet Opening: Festive Crowd
After casting Ultimate, Mad Pleasure: Shadowbringer rapidly moves between chains to deal fatal Ice DMG to enemies. While casting Ultimate, she is invincible and Time-frozen Domain is triggered, which pauses all skill and stage timers.

◆ Astral Ring Skill - Joint Celebration: Praise My Name
Mad Pleasure: Shadowbringer is protected by Astral Ring Specialization: Wheel of Destiny. Upon entering Stellar Outburst, characters cannot be switched and those on standby will morph into Phantoms to provide support in battle. Mad Pleasure: Shadowbringer will gain a buff, and her attacks will generate Phantoms to deal bonus DMG and recover Banquet Enjoyment, while increasing DMG for the next Moment of Indulgence.


☆☆☆☆☆ Recommended Equipment ☆☆☆☆☆

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41350040/1b022846fdffcad28709bbd1856d05d6df56aa73.png[/img]

◆ Banquet Rose
Active skill Manor of Chaos: When Ultimate hits an enemy, Mad Pleasure: Shadowbringer can cast the skill to freeze enemies and trigger Time-frozen Domain. After the Time-frozen Domain ends, enemies will be unfrozen, and Ice DMG will be dealt to enemies. Enemies who take this DMG will take more Total DMG.

Passive skill Tilted Goblet: Mad Pleasure: Shadowbringer can cast the skill to gain initial KE and increase the additional Ice DMG and the original DMG dealt by the next Moment of Indulgence. When Astral Ring Specialization: Wheel of Destiny is activated, characters protected by Astral Ring Specialization: Wheel of Destiny deal more Elemental and Physical DMG.

Synergy skill Brittle Shackles: Enemies take more Total DMG from characters on the field. When used by Mad Pleasure: Shadowbringer, reduces SP cost when casting Ultimate for the first time.


◆ Splendors of Amber Set
2-piece set bonus In a Moment of Splendor: Increases Total DMG. When equipped by Mad Pleasure: Shadowbringer and Astral Ring Specialization: World Star is activated, for every character protected by Astral Ring Specialization: World Star, enemies take more Lightning DMG and Total DMG.

3-piece set bonus Centenary Glow: The character takes less Total DMG and deals more Ice DMG. When equipped by Mad Pleasure: Shadowbringer, all enemies take more Ice DMG from her. When Astral Ring Specialization: World Star is activated, enemies take more Total DMG from Resonance Attacks. When Astral Ring Specialization: Wheel of Destiny is activated, characters with Astral Ring Specialization: Wheel of Destiny will trigger Share a Glass with their attacks.


◆ How to Get Equipment
After the v7.4 update and until 04:00, JUN 6, play the login event Banquet Invitation to get Splendors of Amber Stigma Option x1, which grants one of Mad Pleasure: Shadowbringer's recommended stigmata.

After the v7.4 update, Mad Pleasure: Shadowbringer's recommended equipment items are likely to drop in Equipment Supply. Chained Blades Banquet Rose or a stigma from the Splendors of Amber set is guaranteed in 10 drops. Weapon Banquet Rose is guaranteed in 60 drops.

You can also consume AE Imaginon x150 to craft 4★ Chained Blades Phantom Seafarer. Splendors of Amber set will also be craftable, and forging a stigma requires Source Prism x2 and Ether Fuel x600.
