notes.title: Featured Event A Feast Sought in Data Begins!
notes.content:
☆☆☆☆☆ A Feast Sought in Data ☆☆☆☆☆
Exploring the wondrous food ingredients and dangerous illusions in the Sea of Data... That's not really a Holiday Internship, right?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41350040/bf4faa330bba98d8255a5c05b52ee976b9d8ee8e.png[/img]


☆☆☆☆☆ Event Rewards ☆☆☆☆☆
Play the new event A Feast Sought in Data to get Disciplinary Perdition's new outfit Butterfly Dreams, Crystals, Food Hunt Emblem, Reroll Device: ATK Option Type C, Valkyrie Boltstorm Fragments, Valkyrie Blastmetal Fragments and more!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41350040/62f0643b0e07a1b57956e5431cd90f58c4e9e0f2.png[/img]


☆☆☆☆☆ Gameplay Preview ☆☆☆☆☆
In the new event A Feast Sought in Data, you will be teaming up with Sweet, the restaurant owner, to run the show. The aim is to serve up delectable dishes to customers and boost the restaurant's culinary reputation. Exploring the Sea of Data to gather food ingredients and unlock new recipes is also a vital part of this gastronomic adventure.

★ Embark on the journey to create a five-star restaurant!
Good management will not only enhance the culinary rating but also unlock more decor options for Sweet Tooth. You are urged to work toward achieving a prestigious five-star status for Sweet Tooth!

Discover unique dishes and craft the daily menu with Weather and Food Trends in mind to attract more customers and boost revenue!

To keep things exciting, the restaurant needs to innovate various signature dishes, such as the dragon wing soup that's currently the biggest hit!

During your stint as the restaurant manager, feedback from customers will be received. For positive reviews, keep up the good work, and for negative feedback, don't let it dent your confidence!


★ Customer is King!
At the start of the restaurant venture, due to a shortage of staff, Dreamseeker has to step into the role of a waitress. She's not only responsible for serving dishes promptly to prevent customers from getting impatient, but also for clearing tables after meals to attract new customers.

As the restaurant level increases, Dreamseeker's role shifts. Now an indispensable force in the kitchen, she excels in cooking delicious meals! During cooking, you can speed up dish preparation through manual operation.

In the restaurant management process, Dreamseeker can even climb the ranks to become a restaurant manager. At this stage, she can handpick suitable staff for both the dining area and the kitchen. Organizing staff duties strategically can significantly boost the restaurant's revenue.


★ Adventure in the Sea of Data
In the Sea of Data, you can gather food ingredients and new recipes through battles, and unlock various Expansion Equipment to enhance combat abilities.

With further exploration, you can unlock three new weapons: Stun Baton, Propulsion Hammer, and Bow. Each weapon comes with unique Evasion Skill and Charged ATK, so please experience them firsthand in combat.

Expansion Equipment consists of over a dozen combat items, like Spraying Blades that summon a movable storm to attack enemies or Portable Gravity Sphere that creates small black holes to gather enemies. These items will provide you with substantial assistance in combat.


That wraps up the introduction to the new event A Feast Sought in Data. We look forward to meeting you at the renowned Sweet Tooth restaurant in Oxia!


※ The above info is subject to change in the official release.

notes.title: The Mars Squad debuts!
notes.content:
Senadina's S-rank battlesuit Deepspace Anchor: First Light,New A-rank battlesuit Valkyrie Boltstorm ,New A-rank battlesuit Valkyrie Blastmetal debuts! Today we'll introduce her. Read on to learn more!

☆☆☆☆☆ Deepspace Anchor: First Light ☆☆☆☆☆

"Hey there, world!" This girl, born from the Sea of Data, is super curious about everything around her. On the journey of pursuing dreams, she will accompany you to experience all sorts of adventures and meet a bunch of interesting folks. By the way, if she swings by late at night, make sure to treat her to some barbecue.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41350040/c32bf28be7eec82f80ce078952ee6579988d39b0.jpg[/img]


Character Type: Stardust

Weapon: Drive Core

DMG Type: Lightning

Astral Ring Specialization: World Star

◆ How to Get the Battlesuit

After the v7.3 update and until 12:00, MAR 29, the Battlesuit Supply Hello, Mars! for Deepspace Anchor: First Light will be available. Deepspace Anchor: First Light, the featured S-rank battlesuit, is guaranteed in 90 drops.

☆☆☆☆☆ Skill Showcase ☆☆☆☆☆

Deepspace Anchor: First Light wields a Drive Core to fight on the ground and in the air by unleashing various Thunderous Strikes that deal massive DMG. During Stellar Outburst, she can leave a Domain Resonance mark to activate Resonance effects with the team's Resonance Attacks to deal continuous bonus DMG.

◆ Basic ATK: Luoxing Spin: Stardust Flux

Deepspace Anchor: First Light can wield Drive Core on the ground or in the air to perform a 4-sequence combo that deals Lightning DMG. The 4th strike will grant her Thunderous Pulse on hit. Evading and jumping will not reset Basic ATK combo hits.



◆ Weapon Skill: Dazzling Moment: Galactic Pulsation

When Deepspace Anchor: First Light doesn't have Thunderous Pulse, tap [Weapon] to hurl her Drive Core toward the enemy and quickly approach her target.

When Deepspace Anchor: First Light has Thunderous Pulse, her weapon skill is replaced by Thunderous Strike, which deals Lightning DMG to enemies and lets the character enter Thunderous Blazar. This attack can connect to Basic ATK SEQ 4 and gather Stardust Remnants.

When Deepspace Anchor: First Light is in Thunderous Blazar, her Thunderous Strike will pull in nearby enemies to deal higher Lightning DMG. The attack will grant Thunderous Pulse again on hit and switch Thunderous Strike to Thunder in Clear Skies, unleashing the blades on the Drive Core to deal massive Lightning DMG by slashing enemies.

The character has higher Ignore Interrupt in Thunderous Blazar.



◆ Evasion Skill: Dimension Crack: Starlight Glide

During Deepspace Anchor: First Light's evasion or gliding, if there is Ultimate Evasion Skill charge, tap [ATK] to trigger Ultimate Evasion Skill and connect to Basic ATK SEQ 3. Hold [EVA] while evading forward to make Senadina glide continuously. If there is Ultimate Evasion Skill charge when she is hit while gliding, she evades the damage and triggers Ultimate Evasion Skill. You can reset evasion count by casting Thunder in Clear Skies and Lightning Flash Anchor.



◆ Ultimate: Thunderous Discharge: Stellar Irontide

Deepspace Anchor: First Light charges the Drive Core with lightning and uses it to attack rapidly, and the final lightning explosion deals massive Lightning DMG. While casting Ultimate, the character is invincible and triggers Time-frozen Domain.



◆ Astral Ring Skill: Asterism: The Light That Protects the World

When Deepspace Anchor: First Light is protected by Astral Ring Specialization: World Star with Astral Ring activated, Total DMG dealt by the character's weapon skill is increased.

After entering Stellar Outburst, Deepspace Anchor: First Light exits Thunderous Blazar and resets Drive Skill's overheat. Meanwhile, she will gain Thunderous Pulse again and gain Quantum Mech Energy. During Stellar Outburst, Quantum Mech Energy will be consumed to upgrade Thunder in Clear Skies to Lightning Flash Anchor, dealing massive Lightning DMG and pulling in nearby enemies. This attack counts as Resonance Attack.

After activating Astral Ring Specialization: World Star, Lightning Flash Anchor will leave a Domain Resonance mark to activate Resonance effects with the team's Resonance Attacks and generate an electromagnetic field that deals Lightning DMG and restores SP. DMG from the electromagnetic field is regarded as weapon skill attacks and Resonance DMG.

☆☆☆☆☆ Valkyrie Boltstorm ☆☆☆☆☆

Say goodbye to the usual routine, set out on an adventure; cross the starry skies and sail across the "sea". Bright ideals lie just ahead.

Helia doesn't often inquire about the destination of a journey — she's always on the move.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41350040/c020e03f3421706828c07005f4dbd4937794be67.jpg[/img]

Character Type: MECH

Weapon: Rapid-Shot Crossbow

DMG Type: Lightning

Astral Ring Specialization: World Star

◆ How to Get the Battlesuit

After the v7.3 update and until 12:00, MAR 29, the Battlesuit Supply Hello, Mars! will be available. You are more likely to obtain Deepspace Anchor: First Light and Valkyrie Boltstorm.

Play Part 2 main story and the new version event to get Valkyrie Boltstorm Fragments.

☆☆☆☆☆ Skill Showcase ☆☆☆☆☆

Valkyrie Boltstorm is a new A-rank battlesuit who attacks by rapidly shooting enemies. After casting Ultimate, she will throw an explosive device and immediately detonate it to deal massive Lightning DMG to all enemies.

◆ Basic ATK: A Journey That Just Began

Tap [ATK] when she is on the ground to perform a 4-sequence combo that deals Lightning DMG to enemies on the ground or in the air.

Tap [ATK] when she is in the air to shoot bolts that deal Lightning DMG and return to the ground.

Basic ATK lets Valkyrie Boltstorm restore Rapid Shot Energy.

  

◆ Special ATK: Footsteps of Faith

With full Rapid Shot Energy, tap [ATK] to let Valkyrie Boltstorm enter Rapid Shot state.

During Rapid Shot, swipe the screen to switch the attack target, or move around and perform evasions. When Rapid Shot Energy is lowered to a certain value, tap [Weapon] again to exit Rapid Shot and trigger Targeted Bombardment, dealing AoE Lightning DMG and knocking enemies away. Targeted Bombardment on hit will provide Thunder Surge to the team, increasing the team's elemental DMG and Lightning DMG.

  

◆ Weapon Skill: Life's Invitation

When Rapid Shot Energy is not full, tap [Weapon] to let Valkyrie Boltstorm throw an explosive device at enemies and deal AoE Lightning DMG centering on enemies hit. The first enemy hit by the explosive device will enter Homing Blast state, which has 7 points and decreases by 1 when any team member lands a hit. Once it reaches 0, it explodes to deal AoE Lightning DMG and inflict Paralyze Trauma.

After Valkyrie Boltstorm throws an explosive device, immediately tap [ATK] to trigger a follow-up and recover Rapid Shot Energy, and the final strike directly triggers Homing Blast.

  

◆ Ultimate: A Prominent Declaration

After casting Ultimate, Valkyrie Boltstorm throws an explosive device that immediately explodes to deal Lightning DMG to all enemies. The enemies hit by Ultimate will be inflicted with Thunder Tangle and take more Elemental DMG and Lightning DMG.

  

◆ Astral Ring Skill: Sidereal: The Whistle of a Dove

Protected by Astral Ring Specialization: World Star, Valkyrie Boltstorm enters Stellar Outburst with increased firing rate and weapon skill Total DMG, during which Targeted Bombardment can be triggered upon exiting Rapid Shot. During Stellar Outburst, entering Rapid Shot for the first time throws an explosive device and leaves energy masses with Domain Resonance marker on the field, which can be activated by any teammates' Resonance Attacks to trigger a Chain Lightning that deals Lightning DMG.

Upon entering Stellar Outburst, Valkyrie Boltstorm gives Thunder Surge to all teammates and inflicts Thunder Tangle on all enemies. The effects of Thunder Surge and Thunder Tangle will be enhanced, and the enemies inflicted by Thunder Tangle will take more Total DMG from Resonance.

  
☆☆☆☆☆ Valkyrie Blastmetal ☆☆☆☆☆

When it comes to reality, Coralie has never had high expectations. But in that moment when the countless stars spread out before her eyes, she did hear a clear and loud voice.

"Yeah. Einstein was right. I've... really come to the right place."

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41350040/ceafff85a69002ad43ade13eedee3301e3b93ed8.jpg[/img]

Character Type: PSY

Weapon: Rocket Hammer

DMG Type: Fire

Astral Ring Specialization: Rite of Oblivion

◆ How to Get the Battlesuit

After the v7.3 update, you can play Part 2 Chapter I to get Valkyrie Blastmetal Character Card as early as day 1.

After the v7.3 update, you can also get Valkyrie Blastmetal Character Card from Battlesuit Supply.

Play the main story and other events of the new version to get Valkyrie Blastmetal Fragments.

☆☆☆☆☆ Skill Showcase ☆☆☆☆☆

Valkyrie Blastmetal can use the thrust of Rocket Hammer to evade and attack. While attacking, she can increase the DMG that enemies take and all team members deal. After activating Stellar Outburst, her attacks can resonate with Domain Resonance marks to deal bonus DMG.

◆ Basic ATK: Gently Wakes Up Sleeping Hearts

When Valkyrie Blastmetal is on the ground, tap [ATK] to perform a 3-sequence combo, and the 3rd sequence is an upward swing that lifts the enemy into the air. Tap [ATK] in the air to raise the hammer and smash the enemy down to the ground. Each sequence of Basic ATK adds a stack of Hammering Feel on hit.



◆ Weapon Skill: Secretly Sweeping Away Obstacles

As Valkyrie Blastmetal, tap [ATK] to cast Basic ATK. If she has Hammering Feel, a stack of it will be consumed to change the attack to Weapon-enhanced ATK.

Ground Weapon-enhanced ATK: She can perform a 3-sequence combo, whose 1st sequence homes in better, 2nd sequence pulls nearby enemies, and 3rd sequence reduces the Fortitude of enemies hit.

Aerial Weapon-enhanced ATK: She uses the thrust of Rocket Hammer to spin herself and damage enemies multiple times.

Consuming Hammering Feel provides Let it Burn to the team, which increases Total DMG dealt.



◆ Combo ATK: Slightly Hitting Harder

After casting Aerial Basic ATK or Weapon-enhanced ATK, tap [Weapon] to cast Combo ATK. If she has Hammering Feel when casting Combo ATK, a stack of it will be consumed to change the attack to A Serious Hammering.

A Serious Hammering can pull in nearby enemies, deal Fire DMG multiple times, and inflict Serious Breakdown that increases their Total DMG taken.



◆ Ultimate: Quietly Blasting Open Shut Doors

Coralie jumps on the Rocket Hammer and starts charging up before propelling herself towards to the enemies to cause a large-scale explosion.

While charging, mash the highlighted button to increase the final explosion's DMG. Casting Ultimate increases the homing ability of the next Basic ATK or Weapon-enhanced ATK.



◆ Astral Ring Skill: Carinae: Secretly Relying on the Rite of Oblivion

After entering Stellar Outburst, Valkyrie Blastmetal can continuously cast Weapon-enhanced ATK in the air and replace Hammering Feel with 5 stacks of Quantum Mech Energy. Weapon-enhanced ATK will consume Quantum Mech Energy to resonate with Domain Resonance mark to deal bonus DMG.
※ The above info is subject to change in the official release.

Fixed an issue where the screen sometimes glitched when she cast weapon skill Total Coverage upon entering battle with Star Destroyer 19C-X equipped.

◆ Battlesuit Rule Adjustment
Increased the number of returned Fragments/Souls when obtaining a duplicate S-rank Battlesuit from "30/70" to "50/150." Please refer to Part 2 Development Special Mars Newsletter for more details.



☆☆☆☆☆ Weapons ☆☆☆☆☆
◆ Weapon Synergy Mechanics
New Weapon Synergy Mechanics:
1. New 4★ weapons released after v7.3 will have Synergy mechanics and start at Synergy Rank 1. You can consume up to 2 of the same weapon to enhance it to Synergy Rank 3.

2. New 4★ weapons have Synergy Skills. Increase your Synergy Rank to enhance the Synergy Skills.

3. For weapons with Synergy mechanics, you can only consume those weapons to forge them into PRI-ARMs.

4. Consume the corresponding Modification Boxes to complete Synergy for the recommended weapons of new A-rank battlesuits.


◆ Divine Keys
Adjusted the ways of upgrading Divine Keys Judgment of Shamash, Jizo Mitama, Grips of Tai Xuan, Cleaver of Shamash, and Star of Eden. Soulium will no longer be used for upgrading.

*After the v7.3 update, Soulium will be converted to Coins in a certain ratio.



☆☆☆☆☆ AstralOp/ELF ☆☆☆☆☆
◆ AstralOp System
1. New AstralOp System. After reaching Lv. 30, you can unlock the AstralOp System and get S-rank AstralOp Dreamseeker.

2. New S-rank AstralOp Songque, which can be obtained from AstralOp Supply.

3. AstralOp System Details:
A. When the leader has Astral Ring, an AstralOp can be assigned (or an ELF can be assigned to the team as an AstralOp). If the leader doesn't have Astral Ring, only an ELF can be assigned.

B. After activating Astral Ring in battle, AstralOp will enter to attack and further enhance the buffs provided by Astral Ring.

C. Added Astral Ring Skills to ELFs. Adjusted the upgrade material to unlock Astral Ring Skills from Mind Stones to Operation Terminals. The Mind Stones you own will be converted to Operation Terminals at a 1:1 ratio.


◆ Other Changes
1. Lowered the required level for the ELF System, allowing you to unlock ELF Jingwei's Wings at Lv. 30.

2. Removed the entrance to ELF Book of Fuxi and Bella Trial Stages.



☆☆☆☆☆ Stigmata ☆☆☆☆☆
1. New stigma type, Prism Stigma, which is the recommended stigma for all battlesuits released after the v7.3 update. Prism Stigmata can be forged, and there will be an adjustment to the materials and number of materials required for upgrades. Salvaging a Prism Stigma grants Source Prism x1. The stigmata released before v7.3 and their corresponding materials and number of materials required for upgrades will remain unchanged.

2. Adjusted the effects of some stigma affixes:
A. Adjusted "Javelin users gain bonus ATK" to "Javelin and Drive Core users gain bonus ATK".

B. Adjusted "Heavy and Scythe Wielders gain bonus ATK" to "Cannon, Scythe, and Rocket Hammer users gain bonus ATK".

C. Adjusted "Lance and Pistol Wielders gain bonus ATK" to "Pistols, Lance, and Crossbow users gain bonus ATK".



☆☆☆☆☆ Enemies ☆☆☆☆☆
◆ Flame-Chaser - Kalpas
Fixed an issue where his Fire DMG resistance didn't take effect.


◆ Huodou
1. Fixed an issue where its skill judgment sometimes glitched.

2. Added the skill Nothing but Trouble to Huodou for Superstring Dimension's Bloodbane: Perilous and Memorial Arena's SS difficulty and below. Skill Description: Huodou has higher Ignite Resist but takes more Total DMG when frozen or bleeding. This new skill is merely additional information for Huodou's mechanics and does not affect Huodou's actual stats.


◆ Alien Guard - Purification
Lowered the enemy's movement distance when casting some skills.



☆☆☆☆☆ Gameplay ☆☆☆☆☆
◆ Astral Ring Battle Mechanics
New Astral Ring Battle Mechanics:
1. The new battlesuits released after the v7.3 update will have the Astral Ring System, and they can charge the Astral Ring through various methods. When fully charged, Astral Ring will be activated to let the team enter a special enhanced state.

2. When a battlesuit with Astral Ring is assigned as the leader, the team will activate the Astral Ring System.

3. Added a display of Astral Ring Specialization, Astral Ring Attribute, and Astral Ring Skill in the Valkyrie System.

4. Added Astral Ring lineup tips to the lineup screen, which is triggered when a battlesuit with Astral Ring is assigned as the leader.


◆ Realms of Battle
1. Fixed an issue where the event lineup sometimes glitched in some stages and incorrectly carried over the main story's lineup.

2. Fixed an issue where the number of challenge objectives sometimes glitched in Extreme Trial stages.

3. Fixed an issue where the trial character display in stages was affected by the trial character toggle in Armada's Sim Battle.


◆ Elysian Realm
1. New playable battlesuits: Deepspace Anchor: First Light, Valkyrie Boltstorm, and Valkyrie Blastmetal.

2. New boss HOMU Magician for Floor 17 of Deep Sequence.

3. New support Valkyrie Deepspace Anchor: First Light.

4. Updated the stage effects and buff effects of Deep Sequence.

5. Adjusted the effects of some Signets of Infinity, and added new Astral Ring and AstralOp buff effects.

6. New charging method for the Active Skill of Boundless Logos (Remembrance Sigil): Gain 100 Charge when using Astral Ring after entering combat. CD: 4s.

7. A text correction of Signet of Setsuna's description has been made, and it does not affect the Signet's actual effects.

8. Fixed an issue in Elysian Realm where an error in the Punch Stance's Basic ATK sequence may occur when Fenghuang of Vicissitude was carrying the exclusive Signets Blessing of Attainment and Blessing of Arcane Traces.

9. Adjusted the Collection's resistance information on Husk - Nihilius in Deep Sequence Floor 17 from "no special resistance" to "Physical Resist (L)".

10. Adjusted the Collection's resistance information on Parvati in Deep Sequence Floor 17 from "Ice Resist (H), Fire Vulnerability (L)" to "Ice Resist (H), Fire Vulnerability (M)".


◆ Superstring Dimension
1. New stage: SD: Perilous, featuring Meteoroid: Guaymas as the main enemy.

2. New stage: SD: Perilous, featuring Eclipse: Suspended Eye and Eclipse: Greedy Crystalline as the main enemies.

3. New stage: Sparkle: Perilous, featuring Eclipse: Suspended Eye, Jun-Ninja, and Alien Guard - Purification as the main enemies.

4. New stage: Concerto: Perilous, featuring Alien Guard - Amendment and Eclipse: Greedy Crystalline as the main enemies.

5. Fixed an issue in Bloodlust: Perilous where HOMU Magicians sometimes erroneously summoned Mini HOMUs before the countdown ended.

6. Fixed an issue in Superstring Dimension where the Iron Body status icon display was not removed after Huodou's phase change.

7. Fixed an issue in Superstring Dimension's Inferno: Perilous (featuring Herrscher of the Rimestar as the main enemy) where the buff stacks were sometimes incorrect after breaking the Ice Stars on the field.

8. Fixed an issue in Superstring Dimension where boss Dominator of Wolves may be impossible to lock onto during its phase change.

9. Adjusted the Collection's resistance and strategy information on enemies in Superstring Dimension, but it does not affect the actual resistance of enemies.

Affected Enemies:
● Adjusted the Collection's resistance information on boss Argent Knight: Artemis in Fuel: Perilous from "Ice Resist (H), Fire Vulnerability (M)" to "Ice Resist (H), Lightning Resist (M), Physical Resist (M), Fire Vulnerability (M)".

● Adjusted the Collection's resistance information on boss Beast of Yang - Huodou in Bloodbane: Perilous from "Ice Vulnerability (M)" to "no special resistance", and added a new Advantaged Feature: Bleed.

● Adjusted the Collection's resistance information on boss Hellmaru in Frosthelm: Perilous from "Fire Resist (H), Ice Vulnerability (M)" to "Fire Resist (H), Ice Vulnerability (H)".

● Adjusted the Collection's resistance information on boss MHT-3B Nirvana in Headhunt: Perilous from "no special resistance" to "Ice Resist (L), Lightning Resist (L)".

● Adjusted the Collection's resistance information on boss Dominator of Wolves in Purgatory: Perilous from "no special resistance" to "Ice Immunity".

● Adjusted the Collection's resistance information on boss Husk - Nihilius in Nemesis: Perilous from "no special resistance" to "Physical Resist (L)".

● Adjusted the Collection's resistance information on boss Tonatiuh: Sunshade in Quantum: Perilous from "no special resistance" to "Physical Resist (L)".

● Adjusted the Collection's resistance information on boss Herrscher of the Void in Frosthelm: Perilous from "Physical Resist (H), Lightning Resist (H)" to "Physical Resist (H), Lightning Immunity".

● Adjusted the Collection's resistance information on boss Benares in Concerto: Perilous from "no special resistance" to "Physical Resist (H)".

● Adjusted the Collection's resistance information on boss Flame-Chaser - Aponia in Dominance: Perilous from "Fire Resist (M), Lightning Resist (M), Ice Resist (M)" to "Fire Resist (H), Lightning Resist (H), Ice Resist (H)".

● Adjusted the Collection's resistance information on boss Husk - Nihilius in Frosthelm: Perilous from "no special resistance" to "Physical Resist (H)", and added a new Disadvantaged Feature: Physical.

● Adjusted the Collection's resistance information on boss Jizo Mitama in Dominance: Perilous from "Fire Resist (H), Lightning Resist (H), Ice Resist (H)" to "Fire Resist (H), Lightning Resist (H), Ice Resist (H), Physical Resist (M)".

● Adjusted the Collection's resistance information on Parvati in Nemesis: Perilous from "Ice Immunity" to "Ice Immunity, Physical Resist (L)".

● Adjusted the Collection's resistance information on boss Jade Knight in Thunderbane: Perilous from "no special resistance" to "Ice Resist (H), Physical Resist (M)", and added a new Advantaged Feature: Paralyze; and a new Disadvantaged Feature: Ice DMG.


◆ Q-Manifold
Added new enemies in the Unsteady State environment: In Elites and Masters, the enemy on Floor 10 of Sinful rank and Floor 7 of Agony rank is now Alien Guard - Purification; the enemy on Floor 10 of Redlotus rank is now Alien Guard - Supplement.


◆ Memorial Arena
1. New SSS-rank boss Meteoroid: Guaymas.

2. Fixed an issue where SSS-rank boss Flame-Chaser - Aponia's skill Claim Your Penalties, Please didn't deal damage correctly to the target.

3. Fixed an issue where SSS-rank boss HoD Minion's attack animations sometimes glitched during phase change.

4. Fixed an issue where SSS-rank boss Jizo Mitama may be impossible to lock onto during its phase change.

5. New Advantaged Feature for SSS-rank boss Parvati in the Collection — Ignite, but it does not affect the enemy's actual resistance.

6. New Disadvantaged Feature for SSS-rank boss Husk - Nihilius in the Collection — Physical, but it does not affect the enemy's actual resistance.


◆ Co-op
Removed the Co-op mode. If you have not received your Divine Key rewards, they are available from Realms of Battle. Missions associated with Co-op can now be completed at the Realms of Battle.


◆ Universal Mirage
1. Removed the co-op function in Universal Mirage.

2. New normal weapon types available for forging in Foundry: Drive Core, Rapid-Shot Crossbow, and Rocket Hammer.

3. New direct forging methods in Foundry for the stigmata recommended for Deepspace Anchor: First Light, Valkyrie Boltstorm, and Valkyrie Blastmetal.


◆ Main Story
New cost system for Daily Side stages of main story Chapter XIX Into Earth Does the Water Flow.


◆ Open World
1. Added Valkyrie Boltstorm Fragments and Valkyrie Blastmetal Fragments to Adventure Task rewards.

2. Adjusted the required level to unlock Open World: APHO and APHO Chapter 2. They are now unlocked at Lv. 40, and Sakura Samsara is now unlocked at Lv. 50.
*Captains who have unlocked these Open World modes before the v7.3 update will not be affected.

3. Removed Jingwei's Wings Parts and Blood Embrace Parts from Adventure Task rewards.
*Adventure Tasks accepted before the v7.3 update will not be affected.

4. Fixed an issue where Code IX - The Hermit's model animations glitched upon death in APHO Chapter 2.


◆ Material Expedition
Removed the Jingwei's Wings stage from Expedition. Unclaimed Crystals from challenge objectives will be delivered to your mailbox.



☆☆☆☆☆ Supply ☆☆☆☆☆
1. Adjusted the names of Expansion Supply Card, Expansion Supply, and Focused Supply Card to Battlesuit Supply Card, Battlesuit Supply, and Equipment Supply Card respectively.

2. Adjusted the obtention level for UP equipment in Supply events. UP equipment will now be at Lv. 1 instead of Lv. 10 when obtained.

3. Lowered the drop count for the guarantee of obtaining S-rank battlesuits in Battlesuit Supply to 90.

4. Removed Essentines from Battlesuit Supply and Fragment/Soul drops of various Supply events.

5. Removed Battlesuit Shard mechanics and added Stardust Shard mechanics. The Battlesuit Shards you own will be converted to Stardust Shards at a 9:1 ratio.

6. Adjusted some mechanics in Dorm Supply:
A. Removed Battlesuit Fragment/Soul drops and added Midnight Absinthe Character Card and Asterite drops.

B. Adjusted Dorm Supply's secondary drops to Stardust Shards, receive Stardust Shard x3 from each Dorm Supply.

C. New Stardust Shard conversion mechanic, duplicates of fully ranked up A-rank or S-rank battlesuits will be converted to Stardust Shards.


7. Adjusted some mechanics in Starter Special Valkyrie Supply:
A. Removed Battlesuit Fragment/Soul drops.

B. Adjusted Starter Special Valkyrie Supply's secondary drops to Stardust Shards, receive Stardust Shard x5 from each Special Valkyrie Supply.

C. New Stardust Shard conversion mechanic, duplicates of fully ranked up A-rank or S-rank battlesuits will be converted to Stardust Shards.


8. Adjusted some mechanics in Starter Special Equipment Supply:
Adjusted Starter Special Equipment Supply's secondary drops to Stardust Shards, receive Stardust Shard x5 from each Special Equipment Supply.




☆☆☆☆☆ Shop ☆☆☆☆☆
◆ War Treasury
Added Azure Empyrea Character Card, Herrscher of Thunder Character Card, Azure Empyrea Soul, Herrscher of Thunder Soul, and more.


◆ Supply Shop
1. Adjusted the shop's tokens from Battlesuit Shards to Stardust Shards.

2. Added Herrscher of Human: Ego Rank-up Stamp, Palatinus Equinox Rank-up Stamp, Source Prism, and more.


◆ Witch's Corridor
Adjusted the purchasable items with Witch Orbs from A-rank and B-rank Valkyrie Fragments to Valkyrie Fragvyom [A] and Valkyrie Fragvyom [B].


◆ Asterite Shop
1. New exclusive Modification Parts for the recommended weapons of Valkyrie Boltstorm and Valkyrie Blastmetal, and adjusted the order of display for purchasable items in the tab.

2. Added Valkyrie Boltstorm Fragments, Valkyrie Blastmetal Fragments, and Valkyrie Fragvyom [A]; and removed Sündenjäger, Ritual Imayoh, Gyakushinn Miko, Flame Sakitama, Arctic Kriegsmesser, and Luna Kindred from the purchasable Souls.

3. Removed the weekly purchase limit for Jingwei's Wings Parts and Blood Embrace Parts.

4. Removed the Augment Cores category, replaced it with Augment Core Option, and moved it to the Fragments category.


◆ Other Changes
1. Removed the Co-op Shop.

2. Valkyrie Fragvyom [A] in the shop will have more Battlesuit Fragments to choose from. Now, you will need to use Operation Terminals rather than Mind Stones to purchase it.

3. Removed Jingwei's Wings Parts and Blood Embrace Parts from the Logistics Terminal and Armada Terminal.



☆☆☆☆☆ Battle Pass ☆☆☆☆☆
◆ Added the following purchasable items to BP Works:
[Rank-up Stamp] Silverwing: N-EX Rank-up Stamp

[Weapon] Miracle Kissy Pillows

[Stigmata] Devil's Violinist set: Paganini (T, M, B)


◆ Unlock Paladin BP to receive Brilliance in the Air Ribbon.


◆ Unlock Knight BP/Paladin BP to get Exclusive Outfit Option BP Robevyom v7.3. Open it to receive one of the following: Midnight Martini (outfit), Let the Class End (outfit), Crimson Carol (outfit), Simply Orange (outfit), or 8000 Asterite.


◆ Replaced Mind Stone with Operation Terminal in the BP Store.



☆☆☆☆☆ System ☆☆☆☆☆
◆ Achievements
1. New achievement for obtaining Deepspace Anchor: First Light.

2. New achievement for obtaining Valkyrie Boltstorm.

3. New achievement for obtaining Valkyrie Blastmetal.


◆ Bridge Interactions
1. New bridge interactive animations and voice lines for Deepspace Anchor: First Light.

2. New bridge interactive animations and voice lines for Valkyrie Boltstorm.

3. New bridge interactive animations and voice lines for Valkyrie Blastmetal.


◆ System Screens Adjustments
1. Adjusted the battle screen and added a [Jump] button to the lower right corner of the control area.

2. Adjusted the Settings screen.

3. New way to play on PC: Keyboard and Mouse. You will be able to choose your favorite control mode from Controller, Keyboard and Mouse, and Keyboard. In the Keyboard and Mouse Mode, you can move the mouse around to control the character's perspective, cast Basic ATKs with the left mouse button, and perform evasions with the right mouse button during combat scenes.

4. New key position selection that offers two button layouts (Recommended Mode and Classic Mode). You can choose whichever one you prefer. The Ultimate and Jump buttons change position between the two options.

5. Adjusted the options on the Graphics Setting Screen. With the v7.3 update, the options will be automatically set to recommended tiers based on the performance of the device used for login.

*Due to the overall adjustments in options, the settings from before the v7.3 update will not be retained. You can adjust the graphics quality settings according to your preferences by navigating to the Graphics Setting screen.


◆ Bridge System
Unlocks Antares Building, Oxia upon starting the Part 2 main story Chapter I. You can switch to any owned bridges from Account Info → Change Bridge.


◆ Starter's System
1. Adjusted some rewards in the Starter's Manual event.

2. Adjusted some missions and required levels in the Starter's Manual, Sensei-Cadet System, Growth Regimen, and other events.


◆ Collection
A text color correction for some descriptions on Black Wine of Theramenes in the Collection has been made.


◆ Lobby
Removed the Supply tab in the Lobby.


◆ Resources
Added support for Chinese voice acting in the main story CG when Chinese is selected as the voice-over language in the Settings.



☆☆☆☆☆ Dorm ☆☆☆☆☆
Deepspace Anchor: First Light, Valkyrie Boltstorm, and Valkyrie Blastmetal can now move into the Dorm. Their interactions and events are now available.



☆☆☆☆☆ Bug Fixes & Optimizations ☆☆☆☆☆
1. Fixed an issue where crashes sometimes occurred on the Graphics Setting Screen on some iOS devices.


2. Fixed an issue where the hitboxes of some characters sometimes glitched when the game's FPS was unstable.


3. Fixed an issue where the hitboxes of some characters' bullets sometimes glitched.

notes.title: v7.2 The Wings to Mars Update Announcement
notes.content:
Welcome to v7.2: The Wings to Mars!

Remove all troubles and break free from all pains to understand the coming and going.
The heart is like a piece of porcelain that becomes shinier the more it is exposed to fire.
Now, the blaze that has been burning for tens of thousands of years has flared up once more.
New S-rank battlesuit Fenghuang of Vicissitude debuts!

The Star Which the Moon Gazes Upon event begins! Play the event to get Crystals and more!

Featured event Wild Phoenix Chase begins! Play the event to get Reverist Calico's new outfit Meowtose Macchiato, Crystals and more.

New event Realms of Battle begins! Play various themed stages and defeat final bosses to get Crystals, Einstein's Torus and more.



Update Content[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/41350040/63b01ee7dfb49f6a06c0edc8d9e67b4eb804b939.png[/img]
◆ New BIO-type S-rank battlesuit: Fenghuang of Vicissitude
Remove all troubles and break free from all pains to understand the coming and going. The heart is like a piece of porcelain that becomes shinier the more it is exposed to fire.

New S-rank battlesuit Fenghuang of Vicissitude debuts. As a BIO-type Fire DMG dealer, she has great survivability and can switch between Punch Stance and Kick Stance to fiercely attack enemies in battle. When casting Ultimate, she uses herself as a furnace for phoenix fire, and burns away her life to deliver an unparalleled blow.

※ You can obtain the new battlesuit and her recommended equipment in the following ways:
After the v7.2 update, you can participate in the Phoenix Fire Reburns Expansion Supply to obtain Fenghuang of Vicissitude. After specific numbers of drops, you will receive bonus rewards, including Vicissitude Option x3, Flaming Loyal Heart Equipment Option x1, Armory Growth Option x5, Material Option Type A x8, and Fenghuang of Vicissitude Rank-up Stamp x3.

After the v7.2 update, Implicit Simplicity Focused Supply will begin! The UP equipment of Focused Supply A are Fenghuang of Vicissitude's recommended weapon Torch of Eons, and Flavors of Time set: Fu Hua: Ordinary Day (T, M, B).


★ New Event: The Star Which the Moon Gazes Upon
"Imagine if he was fortunate enough to learn the humanity of today is finally treading the path he'd been yearning for — how do you think he'd react?"

New event The Star Which the Moon Gazes Upon begins! Play the event to help three mentors (Kiana, Bronya and Durandal) complete Helia and Coralie's training. Event rewards Crystals, Ancient Willpowers, AE Imaginons and more.


★ Featured Event: Wild Phoenix Chase
"You wanna know what happened? Isn't that obvious — I was riding a bike and singing with the Old Timer when our RV got hijacked by the Jingwei!"

Featured event Wild Phoenix Chase will be available in v7.2! In this event, travel with Fu Hua, Herrscher of Sentience and others to collect marbles and souvenirs during the journey. Use marbles to hit mechanisms and take back the camper!

Play the event to get Reverist Calico's new outfit Meowtose Macchiato, Crystals and more.


★ New Event: Realms of Battle
The realms of battle unfold. It is time to push past the limits and charge toward victory.

New event stages available. During the event, clear themed stages and defeat final bosses to get Crystals, Einstein's Torus and more.


★ Additions to the Hyperion Arsenal
◆ New Weapons: Fists Torch of Eons, and PRI-ARM fists Torch of Eons: Skyfire

◆ New Stigmata: Flavors of Time Set


★ Additions to the Dressing Room
◆ Sugary Starburst's outfit Tonight's My Time!

◆ Reverist Calico's outfit Meowtose Macchiato



Game Adjustments & Optimizations
☆☆☆☆☆ Characters ☆☆☆☆☆
The following data are at max skill level:
◆ Cosmic Expression
1. Fixed an issue where her Weapon Skill sometimes dealt damage to both Nihilus Shell and Nihilus Seed of IMG-type enemies.

2. Fixed an issue on the Valkyrie screen where her model sometimes glitched in Appreciation Mode.


◆ Herrscher of Rebirth
1. Fixed an issue where her skirt model sometimes experienced blurred displays when she was in the outfit Eternal Night's Embrace.

2. Fixed an issue where flower spirit Flora's animations sometimes glitched after she cast Combo ATK in Life Binder when she was in the outfit Eternal Night's Embrace.

3. Fixed an issue where her model sometimes glitched when she had specific bridge interactions.

4. Fixed an issue where her hair model sometimes glitched when continuously using the last hit of Basic ATK while wearing the outfit Eternal Night's Embrace in Elysian Realm.


◆ Herrscher of Finality
Fixed an issue where her animations sometimes glitched when landing after a jump.


◆ Terminal Aide 0017
Optimized her character art display on the lineup screen when she was in the outfit Saccharine Lash-Out.


◆ Chrono Navi
Added a new skill Low Power Preset, which allows players to toggle an alternate visual for the skill Aimer-Λ Domain. This skill is enabled by default upon unlocking.


◆ Starry Impression
Fixed an issue in the Skill screen where the icon for Combo ATK was displayed incorrectly.


◆ Disciplinary Perdition
1. Fixed an issue on the Skill Details screen where her model glitched.

2. A text correction of her skill Its Sin, Irredeemable at SS-rank, 1 star in the Rank-up system has been made, and it does not affect the actual skill effects.


◆ Golden Diva
Fixed an issue where her model glitched on the Skill Details screen.


◆ Infinite Ouroboros
Fixed an issue where her animations sometimes glitched when she was in the outfit Daughter of Corals.


◆ Palatinus Equinox
Fixed an issue where her background visuals sometimes glitched after casting Ultimate when she was in the outfit Nibelungen Traumlied.


◆ Spina Astera
Added a Charged ATK skill description: "Astrum does not decrease while performing Astral Flare: Combust/Astral Flare: Erupt." This is only a text correction and does not affect the actual skill effects.


◆ Starchasm Nyx
Fixed an issue in Foundry where the direct crafting method in the recommended forge for her G3 stigma set Verne was missing.


◆ Herrscher of Sentience
Fixed an issue where her weapon's active skill sometimes inflicted Stun Trauma repeatedly on enemies hit under special circumstances when equipped with Infinite Intimidator or Incredibly Infinite Intimidator.


◆ Bright Knight: Excelsis
Fixed an issued where her model sometimes glitched in Dressing Room.


◆ Valkyrie Gloria
Fixed a discrepancy between the actual effect and the text description of the skill Flaming Lance when it's not at max level.


◆ Valkyrie Accipiter
Fixed an issue where her model sometimes glitched while in standby.


◆ Black Nucleus
Fixed an issue where her model sometimes glitched when she was in the outfit Flower of Evil.


◆ Other
1. Optimized the time of casting certain QTE skills after being triggered by airborne enemies.

2. Fixed some incorrect voice lines at the bridge for Bronya Zaychik.



☆☆☆☆☆ Weapons ☆☆☆☆☆
◆ Seven Thunders of Retribution: Narukami
A typo correction in the text description of the weapon's Passive Skill Inverse has been made, and it does not affect the actual skill effects.


◆ Spirit Guns - Yae
Fixed a discrepancy between the actual effect and text description of the Bleed Trauma inflicted by the weapon's Passive Skill Night Sakura.



☆☆☆☆☆ Stigmata ☆☆☆☆☆
◆ Kiana: Cramming (T)
1. A text correction of the stigma skill description has been made, and it does not affect the actual skill effects.

2. Fixed an issue with incorrect recommended values displayed for the stigma at certain star levels.


◆ Bronya Zaychik (T, M, B)
Fixed an issue where the stigma set skill Echoed Dissonance was triggered abnormally under certain circumstances and was inconsistent with the Inceptive Authority status icon display.



☆☆☆☆☆ Enemies ☆☆☆☆☆
◆ Alien Guard - Supplement
Fixed an issue where the audio glitched upon the enemy's death.


◆ Pishacha
Added new strategy for tackling this enemy, with a new recommended ability Physical.



☆☆☆☆☆ Gameplay ☆☆☆☆☆
◆ Elysian Realm
1. New playable battlesuit: Fenghuang of Vicissitude

2. New boss Parvati for Floor 17 of Deep Sequence

3. Updated the stage effects and buff effects of Deep Sequence.

4. Fixed an issue with the Daybreak Nexus Signet: Daybreak, Lone Beacon where the increase in max HP wasn't working correctly.

5. Fixed an issue in Floor 8 of Deep Sequence, where boss Huodou used Roaring Flame repeatedly in Phase 2.

6. Fixed an issue where some characters' challenge finalization screen was displayed abnormally.

7. Fixed an issue with Golden Diva's skill 1st Movement: Lights effect "makes the target take more Lightning DMG for 20s", where the VFX was wrongly added to the wrong targets.

8. Fixed an issue where Herrscher of Sentience, wearing outfit Ooh! Summer! outfit and carrying the exclusive Signet Blessing of Victory, sometimes experienced weapon model disappearance when casting Combo ATK.


◆ Superstring Dimension
1. New stage: Inferno: Perilous, featuring Herrscher of the Rimestar as the main enemy.

2. New stage: Nemesis: Perilous, featuring Parvati as the main enemy.

3. New stage: Inferno: Perilous, featuring Herrscher of Corruption as the main enemy.

4. Lowered the ATK of enemies in Quantum: Fringe.

5. Lowered the HP of boss Parvati in Fuel: Perilous.

6. Fixed an issue where, after a phase change of boss Alien Guard: Supplement, the camera perspective sometimes glitched during character's combat.


◆ Memorial Arena
1. New SSS boss: Herrscher of the Rimestar

2. Fixed an issue where SSS boss Huodou's attack warning after the phase change was abnormally affected by Time Fracture.

3. Fixed an issue where the model of SSS boss The Thirteen Flame-Chasers: Aponia sometimes disappeared during the phase change.

4. Fixed an issue where SSS boss False God Otto's model sometimes glitched.


◆ Co-op
Fixed an issue in this mode where the Info screen sometimes was displayed abnormally.


◆ Universal Mirage
1. Fixed an issue where boss Frost Parvati on Floor 6 of Illuminated Land sometimes wrongly took DMG.

2. Fixed an issue where Cosmic Expression's Leader Skill Sail of the Starpainter stopped working properly, not increasing initial SP in battle as intended.


◆ Weekday Event

notes.title: Ai-chan's Newsflash: Wild Phoenix Chase coming soon!
notes.content:
New featured event Wild Phoenix Chase will be available in the second week after the version update. This time, you will team up with Fu Hua, Herrscher of Sentience and others to hit mechanisms using marbles. Defeat enemies to take back the camper!

☆☆☆☆☆ Wild Phoenix Chase ☆☆☆☆☆

This was supposed to be a fun and relaxing journey. After handling a series of incidents, Fu Hua and Herrscher of Sentience drove the camper to start the days of journeying with Book of Fuxi.

But good hours didn't last long. While Fu Hua and the others were out shopping, Jingwei and Dark Jingwei stole their camper. A tough battle of chasing the camper back begins...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41350040/fab89d0e940bf6618c35a42454fa102c3d3334ce.png[/img]

  

☆☆☆☆☆ Event Rewards ☆☆☆☆☆

Participate in Wild Phoenix Chase to get the tokens that can be used to exchange for Reverist Calico's new outfit Meowtose Macchiato, Crystals, Energy Devices, Honkai Shards and more in the event shop. Clear a specific challenge stage to get Bossy Jingwei Emblem, on which you can see the highest stage cleared!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41350040/1d2d9aca86ea9c72c4305392381047a15abbb3bc.jpg[/img]

  

☆☆☆☆☆ How to Play ☆☆☆☆☆

During this journey, Fu Hua and others will gather various marbles and souvenirs along the way. They'll deal damage to enemies by shooting marbles at different mechanisms.

After the battle begins, you can adjust the shooting direction and tap a button to shoot the marbles. The more mechanisms the marbles hit, the higher damage they deal to enemies.

★ Concentrate

While shooting marbles, tap the Concentrate button to pause the moving marbles and adjust their bouncing trajectory. Once you're finished, tap the button to shoot the marbles and they will move according to the new trajectory.

★ Recycling

Use the recycling function to strategically use marbles to increase the damage output within the round. Tap the Recycle button to recycle the currently loaded marbles and load the subsequent marbles. You can only use the recycling function up to 2 times in a single battle.

★ Purchase and Star Up

After winning a battle, you can enter the shop to rest. You can use Unparalleled Duo Coins (obtained in battle) to purchase marbles, star up currently owned marbles, delete obsolete marbles from the Inventory, or recover HP.
   [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41350040/43f474ce785b2a9e8b726f2100c4611790fb6233.png[/img]
  

★ Level Up Valkyries

You can use the Divine Phoenix Charms obtained from the event to level up Valkyries in the event. Leveling up Valkyries will increase their stats, unlock Passive Skills, enhance Active Skills, and unlock more exclusive marbles.
  [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41350040/35ae6147e061c09c9d791a67387f0f271b23b441.png[/img]
  

During this journey, you'll also pick up some souvenirs and experience fun modes along the way. More about the journey awaits Captains in the game!
※ The above info is subject to change in the official release.

notes.title: Ai-chan's Newsflash: Wild Phoenix Chase coming soon!
notes.content:
Fu Hua's new S-rank battlesuit Fenghuang of Vicissitude will debut in v7.2! The genes of Garuda have given extraordinary vitality and memory to Fu Hua, so how will she make use of this great power? Check out the new battlesuit info with Ai-chan now!

☆☆☆☆☆ Fenghuang of Vicissitude ☆☆☆☆☆

"Like before, I will always be here."

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41350040/d1dabad3d700baf0010e792c243a1b25054575ad.png[/img]



Plumes: Crossing through vicissitudes this time, she doesn't need to burn her all once more.

Gauntlets & Foot Blades: Seamlessly integrating various martial arts, her body moves in battle as she wishes.

Wings: In the name of Garuda, after thousands of years, the primordial wings rise again from the blaze.

☆☆☆☆☆ Skill Showcase ☆☆☆☆☆

Fenghuang of Vicissitude is a BIO-type melee fighter dealing Fire DMG. With great survivability, she can switch between Punch Stance and Kick Stance in battle.

◆ Parry ATKs: Fiery Cloud Impact and Rampant Blades

Tap [EVA] without touching the joystick, and Fenghuang of Vicissitude enters Parry Stance. If she successfully defends an enemy attack or you tap [ATK], Ultimate Evasion Skill will be triggered directly, and she will cast Parry ATK based on the Stance she is in, while gaining Iron Body, taking less damage, and triggering Time Fracture. If she successfully defends an enemy attack and Ultimate Evasion Skill is still on CD, she will connect to Basic ATK SEQ 3 of the current Stance.

In Punch Stance, cast Parry ATK Fiery Cloud Impact to deal Fire DMG. If she maintains Parry Stance, she can perform a special attack to deal damage to enemies when she finishes.

In Kick Stance, cast Parry ATK Rampant Blades to let Fenghuang of Vicissitude keep kicking as swiftly as the gale and deal Fire DMG.



◆ Joint ATKs: Swirling Uppercut and Vigorous Strike

When Qi is full, hold [ATK] to consume all Qi to cast Combo ATK of the current Stance and enter Qi Accumulation state.

After casting Combo ATK, she can connect to two variants of Joint ATK. After casting Combo ATK, tap [Weapon] to connect to the Joint ATK of the opposite Stance. After casting Combo ATK, tap [ATK] to connect to the Joint ATK of the current Stance.



◆ Enhanced Joint ATKs: Scorching Sun Strike and Burning Wind Sweep

After casting Combo ATK, tap [ATK] to connect to the Joint ATK of the current Stance. After Fenghuang of Vicissitude casts 3 Combo, Joint, or Parry ATKs, Heart Flame will be ignited. After casting Combo ATK, consume Heart Flame to cast the enhanced Joint ATK of the current Stance; this also consumes her HP.

In Punch Stance, cast enhanced Joint ATK Scorching Sun Strike to let Fenghuang of Vicissitude powerfully slam the enemy to the ground, dealing Fire DMG. She is invincible while casting this enhanced Joint ATK.



In Kick Stance, after casting Combo ATK, consume Heart Flame to cast enhanced Joint ATK Burning Wind Sweep, which makes Fenghuang of Vicissitude morph her wings into sharp blades to slash the enemy and deal Fire DMG. She is invincible while casting this enhanced Joint ATK.



◆ Ultimate: Eruption That Churns Tides and Clouds

Fenghuang of Vicissitude uses herself as a furnace for phoenix fire, and burns away her life to deliver an unparalleled blow that deals massive Fire DMG. While casting Ultimate, Fenghuang of Vicissitude is invincible and Time-frozen Domain is triggered. After casting Ultimate, she will enter a new life by recovering some HP through phoenix fire.



☆☆☆☆☆ Equipment ☆☆☆☆☆

After the v7.2 update and until 12:00, FEB 16, Expansion Supply for Fenghuang of Vicissitude will be available. The featured S-rank battlesuit Fenghuang of Vicissitude is guaranteed in 100 drops.

After the v7.2 update and until 12:00, FEB 16, pull certain numbers of drops in the Expansion Supply for Fenghuang of Vicissitude to get Vicissitudes Stigma Option x3, Flaming Loyal Heart Equipment Option x1, Fenghuang of Vicissitude Rank-up Stamp x3 and more. Open Option to get the weapon and stigma recommended for Fenghuang of Vicissitude.

Meanwhile, you can participate in Focused Supply to get UP fists weapon Torch of Eons and stigma set Flavors of Time.

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41350040/f9108f67dd9aadb7c9362a5aeb5e4ba71fca7098.png[/img]

[h1][b]Welcome to the world of Honkai Impact 3rd! [/b][/h1]

[b]Board Hyperion and join the Valkyries in the war against Honkai![/b]

From today until December 2, accumulate logins to obtain *Steam Impact Emblem*, Crystals, and more!

It you're a new Captain, you can click on "Go to Guides" to read fan guides and discuss strategies.

You can also visit miHoYo's official gaming community, HoYoLAB, for more quality guides: [url=https://www.hoyolab.com/guides/1 ]HoYoLAB [/url]

[b]Ai-chan has also written a FAQ for Steam Captains! Ai-chan hopes it helps![/b]



[h1]Honkai Impact 3rd Steam Captains FAQ[/h1]


[b]Q: How do I download the game on Steam?[/b]
A: Log in to Steam and search for "Honkai Impact 3rd" to download the game~

[b]Q: What are the log-in options supported by the Steam version? Does it support cross-save?[/b]
A: We're sorry! Currently, you can only log in to the Steam version, which does not support cross-save, using Steam accounts.


[b]Q: Which servers are available in the Steam version?[/b]
A: You can log in to the European server and the Americas server. You can switch servers in the upper right corner of the log-in screen.

[b]Q: Does the Steam version have the same in-game events and server time as the other versions?[/b]
A: Currently, the content of the Steam version is exactly the same as that of the official European and Americas servers. Please follow our in-game and social media announcements for details.

[b]Q: Can my computer run Honkai Impact 3rd?[/b]
A: It can run the game smoothly if it meets the spec requirements listed on the store page!

[b]Q: Does the Steam version support controller input?[/b]
A: Of course! Like the PC launcher version, the Steam version supports almost all major controllers! You can even configure the controls on the settings screen!


[b]Q: Are there any events or freebies to celebrate Honkai Impact 3rd's Steam release?[/b]
A:
[b]Steam-Exclusive Bonuses:[/b]
 Log in three days to receive three limited-time download gifts via in-game mail; One gift per day. The gifts include a Steam Impact Emblem and 500 Crystals.

[b]Starter Bonuses:[/b]
 New Captains need serious firepower to survive! The Starter's Event on the main screen will help new Captains learn the basics and obtain resources quickly.
 In the Starter's Event, you can participate in 7-Day Login, Level-up Sprint, Path to Greatness, and Starter Bootcamp to obtain up to 80x Dorm Supply Cards and over 14,000 Crystals!
 Note that Starter's Event only lasts 60 days after opening! Please be mindful of the time!

[b]Q: Why can't I find Honkai Impact 3rd in the Steam Store?[/b]
A: Please make sure that Honkai Impact 3rd is downloadable in your Steam Store region.

notes.title: Genshin Impact precursor Honkai Impact 3rd is coming to Steam
notes.content:
MiHoYo's anime RPG Genshin Impact continues to skyrocket in terms of popularity, so fans have wondered why the studio's previous game - the similar anime action title Honkai Impact 3rd - hasn't been made widely available to English-speaking territories. That's apparently about to change as a Honkai Impact 3rd Steam release is coming this month.

Honkai Impact 3rd was originally released in 2016, four years before Genshin Impact, and while it's not a direct sequel there are many elements in common between the two - such as the distinct anime look, social interaction, similar character design, and some similar plot threads.

However, while it's generally available through the game's website in English this month's Steam release will be the first time Honkai Impact 3rd has been made available through a proper mainstream gaming client. Even more interesting is that it's hitting Steam before Genshin Impact has - MiHoYo's more popular title is currently exclusive to the Epic Games Store, although with Honkai Impact 3rd hitting Valve's platform it's entirely possible that will change soon.
